// Bandit Raid — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"casterFoot":null,"partyFoot":0.97,"volume":1,"move":"raid","stagger":150,"runMs":900,"bandits":["bandit","archer","mage","berserker"],"bsc":{"bandit":1.34,"archer":1.35,"mage":1.31,"berserker":1.89},"seed":3301,"totalTimeoutMs":25000};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"hit":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/001_hit_physical.webm","w":488,"h":488,"dur":333,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5}},"images":{"bandit":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Beastiary/Bandit_Standard.png","archer":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Beastiary/BanditArcher_Standard.png","mage":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Beastiary/BanditMage_Standard.png","berserker":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Beastiary/BanditBerserker_Standard.png"},"sfx":{"item":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Item3.ogg","blowL":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitBlowL.ogg"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-rauben-bandit-raid";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Bandit Raid]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Rauben kit (prepended to every Rauben shot by legacy-rauben-signatures.js) ──

// The legacy-boss mockup's shared kit (part-common.js) ported to oni.timeline: sound cues at the

// mockup's loudness, a world-space particle field (dust, coins, twinkles), the afterimage ghost,

// the coin and the thrown axe shapes, depth-scaled bandit runners and the battler size of a bandit.

// Mockup px are on a 1682 px stage; KP scales them to the scene. No backticks, no dollar-brace.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

const VOL = (cfg.volume == null ? 1 : cfg.volume) * 0.75; // mockup sfx(key, v) plays at v * 0.75

const readyHook = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

function RKit(tl, T) {

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const m = tl.mk(T);

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 7331);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const pick = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(R() * arr.length)];

const K = { KP, m, R, rnd, pick, E, seg, lerp };

// the screen px of one mockup stage px (shakes are screen space)

K.SH = () => { try { return tl.view().H / 788; } catch (e) { return 1; } };

// fire once when the run reaches 'at' (a track stays open so a slow frame cannot skip it)

K.once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (did) return; did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[Rauben] cue threw', e); } } }); };

// a sound cue: key in A.sfx, v = the mockup volume; o = { rate, fadeAfter, fadeMs }

K.snd = (at, key, v, o) => { const url = A.sfx && A.sfx[key]; if (!url) return; K.once(at, () => { try { oni.sfx(url, Object.assign({ volume: Math.min(1, v * VOL) }, o || {})); } catch (e) {} }); };

K.shake = (at, ms, px) => { T.push({ t0: at, t1: at + ms, fn: (tt, S) => { S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, px * K.SH() * (1 - tt / ms)); } }); };

K.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2); };

// ── particle field: { t0, life, z, draw(g, u, age) }; z < 5 = under the battlers ──

const P = []; K.P = P;

K.add = (p) => { P.push(p); return p; };

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => {

if (!P.length) return;

const zs = {};

for (let i = P.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = P[i]; if (t >= p.t0 + p.life) { P.splice(i, 1); continue; } if (t < p.t0 || p.dead) continue; (zs[p.z] = zs[p.z] || []).push(p); }

for (const z in zs) { const list = zs[z]; S.world.push({ z: Number(z), draw: (g) => { for (const p of list) { const age = t - p.t0; g.save(); try { p.draw(g, age / p.life, age); } catch (e) {} g.restore(); } } }); }

});

// dust puffs (dustBurst): n puffs thrown up and out from a floor point, drag .97 per frame

K.dust = (at, pt, n, s, rgb, z) => { rgb = rgb || '190,170,140'; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(Math.PI, Math.PI * 2), sp = rnd(0.08, 0.25) * s * KP, vy = rnd(0.02, 0.1) * s * KP, x0 = pt.x + rnd(-10, 10) * s * KP, r = rnd(8, 18) * s * KP;

K.add({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), z: z == null ? 4 : z, draw: (g, u, age) => { const k = (1 - Math.pow(0.97, age / 16.67)) / 0.03 * 16.67; const x = x0 + Math.cos(an) * sp * k, y = pt.y + Math.sin(an) * vy * k; g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.45 * (1 - u)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r * (1 + u), 0, 7); g.fill(); } }); } };

// one drifting puff (a runner's trail)

K.puff = (at, x, y, vx, vy, life, rr, rgb, a0, grow, z) => K.add({ t0: at, life, z, draw: (g, u, age) => { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (a0 * (1 - u)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + vx * age, y + vy * age, rr * (1 + u * grow), 0, 7); g.fill(); } });

// gold twinkles (twinkles)

K.twinkles = (at, pt, n, r, rgb) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = pt.x + rnd(-r, r) * KP, y = pt.y + rnd(-r, r) * 0.8 * KP, s = rnd(5, 11) * KP;

K.add({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), z: 42, draw: (g, u) => { const k = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * s; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; K.glow(g, x, y, k * 2.5, rgb, 0.7); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; g.fillStyle = '#fff';

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y - k * 1.6); g.lineTo(x + k * 0.3, y); g.lineTo(x, y + k * 1.6); g.lineTo(x - k * 0.3, y); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - k * 1.6, y); g.lineTo(x, y + k * 0.3); g.lineTo(x + k * 1.6, y); g.lineTo(x, y - k * 0.3); g.closePath(); g.fill(); } }); } };

// shapes (SHAPE.coin / SHAPE.axe), drawn at the origin

K.coin = (g, age, r) => { const k = Math.abs(Math.cos(age / 70)); g.fillStyle = '#e8b32a'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(0, 0, r * Math.max(0.15, k), r, 0, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#fff3b0'; g.fillRect(-1 * KP, -r * 0.6, 2 * KP, r * 0.5); };

K.axe = (g, s) => { g.scale(s, s); g.strokeStyle = '#4a2f1c'; g.lineWidth = 6; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-30, 0); g.lineTo(30, 0); g.stroke();

g.fillStyle = '#c9ced6'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(18, -4); g.quadraticCurveTo(44, -30, 36, -36); g.quadraticCurveTo(54, -6, 40, 22); g.quadraticCurveTo(40, 6, 18, 4); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.strokeStyle = '#7d1c1c'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke(); };

// a thrown thing (fly): from -> to over ms, arc = mockup px up at mid-flight (negative dips), spin rad per 60 fps frame

K.fly = (at, from, to, o) => { const ms = o.ms; K.add({ t0: at, life: ms, z: o.z == null ? 40 : o.z, draw: (g, u, age) => { const e = (o.ease || E.lin)(Math.min(1, age / ms)); const x = lerp(from().x, to().x, e), y = lerp(from().y, to().y, e) - o.arc * KP * Math.sin(Math.PI * e);

g.translate(x, y); if (o.spin) g.rotate(o.spin * age / 16.67); o.draw(g, age); } }); };

// afterimage: a pale copy of a timeline token's art at its painted spot, fading over ms

K.ghost = (at, k, pose, o) => { o = o || {}; const art = tl.art(k), Tk = tl.TOK[k]; if (!art || !Tk) return; const ms = o.ms || 380, a0 = o.opacity || 0.5;

K.add({ t0: at, life: ms, z: 4, draw: (g, u) => { const f = tl.feet(Tk); g.translate(Tk.x + pose.dx, f.y + pose.dy - (pose.air || 0)); if (pose.rot) g.rotate(pose.rot); g.scale(Tk.flip * (pose.sx || 1), pose.sy || 1); g.globalAlpha = a0 * (1 - u); g.filter = 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)'; g.drawImage(art, -Tk.w / 2, -Tk.h * Tk.foot, Tk.w, Tk.h); } }); };

// the drawn height of a bandit art in the game: a 1x1 token box ("contain") times its texture scale, times the depth there

K.banditH = (img, sc, ds) => { const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; return nh * Math.min(tl.GRID / nw, tl.GRID / nh) * sc * ds; };

// where a body standing on a 2D floor point is drawn, and how big ({ x, y, s })

// cfg.flat (full-takeover shots: the 3D stage flattens) = the 2D point itself, sized by the depth-map factor only

K.floor = (x, y) => { try { const d = oni.depthAt({ x, y }); if (cfg.flat) return { x, y, s: d && Number.isFinite(d.f) && d.f > 0 ? d.f : 1 }; if (d && Number.isFinite(d.s) && d.s > 0) return d; } catch (e) {} return { x, y, s: 1 }; };

// the board edges in world px right now (live board: the real camera)

K.edges = () => { try { const v = tl.camView(tl.makeState()); return { left: v.left, right: v.right, top: v.top, bottom: v.bottom }; } catch (e) { return { left: tl.STAGE.x, right: tl.STAGE.x + tl.STAGE.w, top: tl.STAGE.y, bottom: tl.STAGE.y + tl.STAGE.h }; } };

// a bandit sprite running across the board: img, dir (+1 = to the right), x0 -> x1, row y, h, ms, ease,

// bob(u) mockup px up, rot(u) deg, fade-in ms, z; trail = puff spacing ms (0 = none)

K.runner = (at, o) => { const img = o.img; if (!img) return; const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1, h = o.h, w = h * nw / nh;

const pos = (age) => { const u = Math.min(1, age / o.ms), e = (o.ease || E.lin)(u); return { u, x: lerp(o.x0, o.x1, e), y: lerp(o.y, o.y1 == null ? o.y : o.y1, e) }; };

K.add({ t0: at, life: o.ms, z: o.z, draw: (g, u0, age) => { const p = pos(age); g.translate(p.x, p.y - (o.bob ? o.bob(p.u) : 0)); if (o.rot) g.rotate(o.rot(p.u) * Math.PI / 180 * o.dir); g.scale(-o.dir, 1);

g.globalAlpha = o.fade ? Math.min(1, age / o.fade) : 1; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); } });

if (o.trail) for (let a = 0; a < o.ms; a += o.trail) { const p = pos(a); const tr = o.trailSpec(p, w, h); K.puff(at + a, tr.x, tr.y, tr.vx, tr.vy, tr.life, tr.rr, tr.rgb, tr.a0, tr.grow, tr.z == null ? o.z - 1 : tr.z); }

return { w, h };

};

return K;

}

// ── shot ──

// Rauben · Great Axe (+ Great Axe - Counterattack) / Axe Throw / Bandit Raid / All you can take (inner script, every client).

// Port of the approved legacy-boss mockup (part-b3.js, Rauben defs). LIVE board: the camera is never touched,

// only the bodies a beat moves are painted. cfg.move = "greataxe" | "axethrow" | "raid" | "allyoucan".

// Every damage contact cues oni.hit(); the damage gate (oni.fireDone) sits where the mockup marks it.

// Numbers, flinch and HP bar are the game's. No floating text, no backticks in this file.

if (!caster) { readyHook(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const MOVE = cfg.move;

const ALL = MOVE === 'allyoucan';

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

// All you can take: every creature on the board gains IP (the item's resolution grants it to every token)

const CREW = [];

if (ALL) {

const seen = new Set([caster.id]); const disp = Number(caster.document && caster.document.disposition) || 0; const list = [];

for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (!t || !t.actor || seen.has(t.id) || !t.visible || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; seen.add(t.id); list.push(t); }

list.sort((a, b) => ((Number(a.document.disposition) === disp) ? 1 : 0) - ((Number(b.document.disposition) === disp) ? 1 : 0));

list.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 'c' + i; CREW.push({ k, token: t }); if (!tokens[k]) tokens[k] = { token: t }; });

CREW.push({ k: 'k', token: caster });

}

if (!ALL && !FOES.length) { readyHook(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const A_IMG = A.images || {};

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A_IMG, live: true, depthRef: 'k' });

await tl.load();

const T = [];

const RK = RKit(tl, T);

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = RK.KP, m = RK.m, rnd = RK.rnd;

const CL = A.clips || {};

const K = TOK.k, kf = feet(K);

const center = (k) => { const Tk = TOK[k], f = feet(Tk); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - Tk.h * 0.5 }; };

const DIR = FOES.length ? (feet(TOK[FOES[0]]).x >= kf.x ? 1 : -1) : (() => { const o = CREW.find((c) => c.k !== 'k' && Number(c.token.document.disposition) !== Number(caster.document.disposition)); return o && feet(TOK[o.k]).x < kf.x ? -1 : 1; })();

const D2R = Math.PI / 180;

// a mockup lean (deg, positive = toward the party) as a canvas rotation

const lean = (deg) => deg * DIR * D2R;

const clipW = (key, scale) => CL[key].w * scale * 0.55 * KP;

// keyframed value: keys [{ t0, ms, to, ease }] run back to back from 0

const curve = (keys, t) => { let v = 0; for (const q of keys) { if (t < q.t0) break; v = lerp(v, q.to, (q.ease || E.outQ)(seg(t, q.t0, q.t0 + q.ms))); } return v; };

let total = 0, gate = 0, poseAt = null;

if (MOVE === 'greataxe') {

// ── Great Axe: dash, overhead swing, hit, two coins to him, back ──

const tk = FOES[0], tf = feet(TOK[tk]), c = center(tk);

const DEST = { x: tf.x - DIR * cfg.gap * KP * tl.depthRatio(kf, tf), y: tf.y };

const D = cfg.dash, WIND = D + cfg.wind, CUT = WIND + cfg.swing, STEAL = CUT + cfg.hitstop, GATE = STEAL + cfg.coinMs, SETTLE = GATE + cfg.settle, HOME = SETTLE + cfg.home;

total = HOME + 300; gate = GATE;

const rotKeys = [{ t0: D, ms: cfg.wind, to: -16 }, { t0: WIND, ms: cfg.swing, to: 16 }, { t0: GATE, ms: cfg.settle, to: 0 }];

poseAt = (t) => { let x = kf.x, y = kf.y, air = 0;

if (t < D) { const u = E.ioQ(seg(t, 0, D)); x = lerp(kf.x, DEST.x, u); y = lerp(kf.y, DEST.y, u); }

else if (t < SETTLE) { x = DEST.x; y = DEST.y; }

else { const u = E.ioQ(seg(t, SETTLE, HOME)); x = lerp(DEST.x, kf.x, u); y = lerp(DEST.y, kf.y, u); air = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * cfg.hop * KP; }

return { dx: x - kf.x, dy: y - kf.y, air, rot: lean(curve(rotKeys, t)), sx: 1, sy: 1 }; };

// the dash leaves three afterimages (trail .3 of the eased move)

for (const e of [0.3, 0.6, 0.9]) { const u = e < 0.5 ? Math.sqrt(e / 2) : 1 - Math.sqrt((1 - e) / 2); const at = Math.round(u * D) + 1; RK.ghost(at, 'k', poseAt(at)); }

RK.snd(WIND, 'swingF', 0.55);

m.clip('slash3', CUT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('slash3', 1.2), z: 40 });

RK.once(CUT, () => oni.hit());

RK.snd(CUT, 'blowL', 0.6); RK.shake(CUT, 260, 10);

RK.snd(STEAL, 'steal', 0.45); RK.snd(STEAL, 'coin', 0.45);

// coinsTo: two coins hop from the target to him (resolves when the first lands = the gate)

const to = () => ({ x: DEST.x, y: DEST.y - K.h * tl.depthRatio(kf, DEST) * 0.5 });

for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { const ox = rnd(-12, 12) * KP, arc = rnd(70, 130); RK.fly(STEAL + i * 70, () => ({ x: c.x + ox, y: c.y }), to, { ms: cfg.coinMs, arc, ease: E.sine, z: 41, draw: (g, age) => RK.coin(g, age, 7 * KP) }); }

}

if (MOVE === 'axethrow') {

// ── Axe Throw: a spinning axe flies out, hits, and arcs back into his hand ──

const tk = FOES[0], c = center(tk);

const hand = () => ({ x: kf.x + DIR * K.w * 0.3, y: kf.y - K.h * 0.62 });

const W1 = cfg.wind, HIT = W1 + cfg.out, BACK = HIT + cfg.back, SQ = BACK + 90, SQ2 = SQ + 120, END = SQ2 + 140;

total = END + 300; gate = HIT;

const rotKeys = [{ t0: 0, ms: cfg.wind, to: -12 }, { t0: W1, ms: 100, to: 10 }, { t0: SQ2, ms: 140, to: 0 }];

const sqKeys = (t) => t < BACK ? 1 : t < SQ ? lerp(1, 1.05, E.outQ(seg(t, BACK, SQ))) : lerp(1.05, 1, E.outQ(seg(t, SQ, SQ2)));

poseAt = (t) => { const sx = sqKeys(t), sy = 2 - sx; return { dx: 0, dy: 0, air: 0, rot: lean(curve(rotKeys, t)), sx, sy }; };

RK.snd(W1, 'swingC', 0.5);

RK.fly(W1, hand, () => c, { ms: cfg.out, arc: 60, spin: 0.35, z: 40, draw: (g) => RK.axe(g, 1.1 * KP) });

m.clip('slash', HIT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('slash', 1), z: 41 });

RK.once(HIT, () => oni.hit());

RK.snd(HIT, 'blowL', 0.5); RK.snd(HIT, 'swingA', 0.4);

RK.fly(HIT, () => c, hand, { ms: cfg.back, arc: -70, spin: 0.35, z: 40, draw: (g) => RK.axe(g, 1.1 * KP) });

}

if (MOVE === 'raid') {

// ── Bandit Raid: he whistles; three bandits dash through the target from off-screen, one hit at the end ──

const tk = FOES[0], tf = feet(TOK[tk]), c = center(tk);

const W0 = 160, WEND = W0 + 300 + 160, RUN = WEND;

const LAST = RUN + 2 * cfg.stagger + cfg.runMs;

total = LAST + 400; gate = LAST;

const rotKeys = [{ t0: 0, ms: 160, to: 6 }, { t0: W0 + 300, ms: 160, to: 0 }];

poseAt = (t) => ({ dx: 0, dy: 0, air: 0, rot: lean(curve(rotKeys, t)), sx: 1, sy: 1 });

RK.snd(W0, 'item', 0.4);

const ed = RK.edges();

const x0 = (DIR > 0 ? ed.left : ed.right) - DIR * 120 * KP, x1 = (DIR > 0 ? ed.right : ed.left) + DIR * 218 * KP;

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

const art = RK.pick(cfg.bandits), img = tl.IMG[art]; if (!img) continue;

const y = tf.y + (i - 1) * 18 * KP, h = RK.banditH(img, cfg.bsc[art] || 1.34, tl.depthS(tf.x, y)), z = y < tf.y ? 3 : 30;

RK.runner(RUN + i * cfg.stagger, { img, dir: DIR, x0, x1, y, h, ms: cfg.runMs, ease: E.lin, z,

bob: (u) => Math.abs(Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 9)) * 8 * KP, rot: (u) => Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 9) * 4,

trail: 64, trailSpec: (p) => ({ x: p.x - DIR * 20 * KP, y: p.y, vx: -0.05 * DIR * KP, vy: -0.02 * KP, life: 500, rr: rnd(5, 10) * KP, rgb: '190,170,140', a0: 0.4, grow: 1 }) });

}

m.clip('hit', LAST, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('hit', 1), z: 41 });

RK.once(LAST, () => oni.hit());

RK.snd(LAST, 'blowL', 0.5);

}

if (MOVE === 'allyoucan') {

// ── All you can take: dim, he steps up, coins shower onto every creature, the game's IP number reads the gain ──

const STEP = cfg.step, SHOWER = STEP;

const N = CREW.length, ARRIVE = 560;

const GATE = SHOWER + (N - 1) * 70 + ARRIVE;

const BACK = GATE + 500, HOME = BACK + cfg.home;

if (!('current_ip' in p) || !('max_ip' in p)) { const s = (actor && actor.system) || {}; cur = Number(s.current_ip); max = Number(s.max_ip); }

const bdNumbers = () => { try { return globalThis.FUCompanion.api.experimental.battleDirector.damageNumbers; } catch (e) { return null; } };

CREW.forEach((cr, i) => {

const at = SHOWER + i * 70, Tk = TOK[cr.k]; if (!Tk) return;

const home = () => { const f = feet(Tk); const dx = cr.k === 'k' ? DEST.x - kf.x : 0; return { x: f.x + dx, y: f.y - Tk.h * 0.5 }; };

for (let n = 0; n < 5; n++) { const ox = rnd(-30, 30) * KP, tx = rnd(-20, 20) * KP;

RK.fly(at, () => ({ x: home().x + ox, y: RK.edges().top - 40 * KP }), () => ({ x: home().x + tx, y: home().y }), { ms: 520 + n * 40, arc: 0, ease: E.inQ, z: 41, draw: (g, age) => RK.coin(g, age, 7 * KP) }); }

RK.snd(at + ARRIVE, 'coin', 0.25);

RK.twinkles(at + ARRIVE, home(), 3, 24, '255,220,120');

if (amount > 0 && uuid) RK.once(at + ARRIVE, () => { const dn = bdNumbers(); if (dn && dn.renderLocal) dn.renderLocal({ kind: 'gain', tokenUuid: uuid, resource: 'ip', amount }); });

// his body, every frame of the shot

m.hold(0, total, (t, S) => { if (!poseAt) return; const p = poseAt(t), d = S.tok.k; d.dx = p.dx; d.dy = p.dy; d.air = p.air; d.rot = p.rot; d.sx = p.sx; d.sy = p.sy; });

RK.once(gate, () => oni.fireDone());

await tl.run(T, { total, onStart: readyHook });

oni.fireDone();

`;

// Great Axe — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"casterFoot":null,"partyFoot":0.97,"volume":1,"move":"greataxe","gap":100,"dash":400,"wind":240,"swing":90,"hitstop":80,"coinMs":520,"settle":160,"home":440,"hop":20,"seed":3301,"totalTimeoutMs":25000};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"slash3":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/025_slash_special_3.webm","w":1186,"h":1206,"dur":2267,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5473}},"sfx":{"swingF":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_SWINGF.wav","blowL":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitBlowL.ogg","steal":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Steal.ogg","coin":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Coin.ogg"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-rauben-great-axe";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Great Axe]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Rauben kit (prepended to every Rauben shot by legacy-rauben-signatures.js) ──

// The legacy-boss mockup's shared kit (part-common.js) ported to oni.timeline: sound cues at the

// mockup's loudness, a world-space particle field (dust, coins, twinkles), the afterimage ghost,

// the coin and the thrown axe shapes, depth-scaled bandit runners and the battler size of a bandit.

// Mockup px are on a 1682 px stage; KP scales them to the scene. No backticks, no dollar-brace.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

const VOL = (cfg.volume == null ? 1 : cfg.volume) * 0.75; // mockup sfx(key, v) plays at v * 0.75

const readyHook = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

function RKit(tl, T) {

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const m = tl.mk(T);

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 7331);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const pick = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(R() * arr.length)];

const K = { KP, m, R, rnd, pick, E, seg, lerp };

// the screen px of one mockup stage px (shakes are screen space)

K.SH = () => { try { return tl.view().H / 788; } catch (e) { return 1; } };

// fire once when the run reaches 'at' (a track stays open so a slow frame cannot skip it)

K.once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (did) return; did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[Rauben] cue threw', e); } } }); };

// a sound cue: key in A.sfx, v = the mockup volume; o = { rate, fadeAfter, fadeMs }

K.snd = (at, key, v, o) => { const url = A.sfx && A.sfx[key]; if (!url) return; K.once(at, () => { try { oni.sfx(url, Object.assign({ volume: Math.min(1, v * VOL) }, o || {})); } catch (e) {} }); };

K.shake = (at, ms, px) => { T.push({ t0: at, t1: at + ms, fn: (tt, S) => { S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, px * K.SH() * (1 - tt / ms)); } }); };

K.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2); };

// ── particle field: { t0, life, z, draw(g, u, age) }; z < 5 = under the battlers ──

const P = []; K.P = P;

K.add = (p) => { P.push(p); return p; };

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => {

if (!P.length) return;

const zs = {};

for (let i = P.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = P[i]; if (t >= p.t0 + p.life) { P.splice(i, 1); continue; } if (t < p.t0 || p.dead) continue; (zs[p.z] = zs[p.z] || []).push(p); }

for (const z in zs) { const list = zs[z]; S.world.push({ z: Number(z), draw: (g) => { for (const p of list) { const age = t - p.t0; g.save(); try { p.draw(g, age / p.life, age); } catch (e) {} g.restore(); } } }); }

});

// dust puffs (dustBurst): n puffs thrown up and out from a floor point, drag .97 per frame

K.dust = (at, pt, n, s, rgb, z) => { rgb = rgb || '190,170,140'; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(Math.PI, Math.PI * 2), sp = rnd(0.08, 0.25) * s * KP, vy = rnd(0.02, 0.1) * s * KP, x0 = pt.x + rnd(-10, 10) * s * KP, r = rnd(8, 18) * s * KP;

K.add({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), z: z == null ? 4 : z, draw: (g, u, age) => { const k = (1 - Math.pow(0.97, age / 16.67)) / 0.03 * 16.67; const x = x0 + Math.cos(an) * sp * k, y = pt.y + Math.sin(an) * vy * k; g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.45 * (1 - u)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r * (1 + u), 0, 7); g.fill(); } }); } };

// one drifting puff (a runner's trail)

K.puff = (at, x, y, vx, vy, life, rr, rgb, a0, grow, z) => K.add({ t0: at, life, z, draw: (g, u, age) => { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (a0 * (1 - u)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + vx * age, y + vy * age, rr * (1 + u * grow), 0, 7); g.fill(); } });

// gold twinkles (twinkles)

K.twinkles = (at, pt, n, r, rgb) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = pt.x + rnd(-r, r) * KP, y = pt.y + rnd(-r, r) * 0.8 * KP, s = rnd(5, 11) * KP;

K.add({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), z: 42, draw: (g, u) => { const k = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * s; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; K.glow(g, x, y, k * 2.5, rgb, 0.7); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; g.fillStyle = '#fff';

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y - k * 1.6); g.lineTo(x + k * 0.3, y); g.lineTo(x, y + k * 1.6); g.lineTo(x - k * 0.3, y); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - k * 1.6, y); g.lineTo(x, y + k * 0.3); g.lineTo(x + k * 1.6, y); g.lineTo(x, y - k * 0.3); g.closePath(); g.fill(); } }); } };

// shapes (SHAPE.coin / SHAPE.axe), drawn at the origin

K.coin = (g, age, r) => { const k = Math.abs(Math.cos(age / 70)); g.fillStyle = '#e8b32a'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(0, 0, r * Math.max(0.15, k), r, 0, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#fff3b0'; g.fillRect(-1 * KP, -r * 0.6, 2 * KP, r * 0.5); };

K.axe = (g, s) => { g.scale(s, s); g.strokeStyle = '#4a2f1c'; g.lineWidth = 6; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-30, 0); g.lineTo(30, 0); g.stroke();

g.fillStyle = '#c9ced6'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(18, -4); g.quadraticCurveTo(44, -30, 36, -36); g.quadraticCurveTo(54, -6, 40, 22); g.quadraticCurveTo(40, 6, 18, 4); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.strokeStyle = '#7d1c1c'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke(); };

// a thrown thing (fly): from -> to over ms, arc = mockup px up at mid-flight (negative dips), spin rad per 60 fps frame

K.fly = (at, from, to, o) => { const ms = o.ms; K.add({ t0: at, life: ms, z: o.z == null ? 40 : o.z, draw: (g, u, age) => { const e = (o.ease || E.lin)(Math.min(1, age / ms)); const x = lerp(from().x, to().x, e), y = lerp(from().y, to().y, e) - o.arc * KP * Math.sin(Math.PI * e);

g.translate(x, y); if (o.spin) g.rotate(o.spin * age / 16.67); o.draw(g, age); } }); };

// afterimage: a pale copy of a timeline token's art at its painted spot, fading over ms

K.ghost = (at, k, pose, o) => { o = o || {}; const art = tl.art(k), Tk = tl.TOK[k]; if (!art || !Tk) return; const ms = o.ms || 380, a0 = o.opacity || 0.5;

K.add({ t0: at, life: ms, z: 4, draw: (g, u) => { const f = tl.feet(Tk); g.translate(Tk.x + pose.dx, f.y + pose.dy - (pose.air || 0)); if (pose.rot) g.rotate(pose.rot); g.scale(Tk.flip * (pose.sx || 1), pose.sy || 1); g.globalAlpha = a0 * (1 - u); g.filter = 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)'; g.drawImage(art, -Tk.w / 2, -Tk.h * Tk.foot, Tk.w, Tk.h); } }); };

// the drawn height of a bandit art in the game: a 1x1 token box ("contain") times its texture scale, times the depth there

K.banditH = (img, sc, ds) => { const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; return nh * Math.min(tl.GRID / nw, tl.GRID / nh) * sc * ds; };

// where a body standing on a 2D floor point is drawn, and how big ({ x, y, s })

// cfg.flat (full-takeover shots: the 3D stage flattens) = the 2D point itself, sized by the depth-map factor only

K.floor = (x, y) => { try { const d = oni.depthAt({ x, y }); if (cfg.flat) return { x, y, s: d && Number.isFinite(d.f) && d.f > 0 ? d.f : 1 }; if (d && Number.isFinite(d.s) && d.s > 0) return d; } catch (e) {} return { x, y, s: 1 }; };

// the board edges in world px right now (live board: the real camera)

K.edges = () => { try { const v = tl.camView(tl.makeState()); return { left: v.left, right: v.right, top: v.top, bottom: v.bottom }; } catch (e) { return { left: tl.STAGE.x, right: tl.STAGE.x + tl.STAGE.w, top: tl.STAGE.y, bottom: tl.STAGE.y + tl.STAGE.h }; } };

// a bandit sprite running across the board: img, dir (+1 = to the right), x0 -> x1, row y, h, ms, ease,

// bob(u) mockup px up, rot(u) deg, fade-in ms, z; trail = puff spacing ms (0 = none)

K.runner = (at, o) => { const img = o.img; if (!img) return; const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1, h = o.h, w = h * nw / nh;

const pos = (age) => { const u = Math.min(1, age / o.ms), e = (o.ease || E.lin)(u); return { u, x: lerp(o.x0, o.x1, e), y: lerp(o.y, o.y1 == null ? o.y : o.y1, e) }; };

K.add({ t0: at, life: o.ms, z: o.z, draw: (g, u0, age) => { const p = pos(age); g.translate(p.x, p.y - (o.bob ? o.bob(p.u) : 0)); if (o.rot) g.rotate(o.rot(p.u) * Math.PI / 180 * o.dir); g.scale(-o.dir, 1);

g.globalAlpha = o.fade ? Math.min(1, age / o.fade) : 1; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); } });

if (o.trail) for (let a = 0; a < o.ms; a += o.trail) { const p = pos(a); const tr = o.trailSpec(p, w, h); K.puff(at + a, tr.x, tr.y, tr.vx, tr.vy, tr.life, tr.rr, tr.rgb, tr.a0, tr.grow, tr.z == null ? o.z - 1 : tr.z); }

return { w, h };

};

return K;

}

// ── shot ──

// Rauben · Great Axe (+ Great Axe - Counterattack) / Axe Throw / Bandit Raid / All you can take (inner script, every client).

// Port of the approved legacy-boss mockup (part-b3.js, Rauben defs). LIVE board: the camera is never touched,

// only the bodies a beat moves are painted. cfg.move = "greataxe" | "axethrow" | "raid" | "allyoucan".

// Every damage contact cues oni.hit(); the damage gate (oni.fireDone) sits where the mockup marks it.

// Numbers, flinch and HP bar are the game's. No floating text, no backticks in this file.

if (!caster) { readyHook(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const MOVE = cfg.move;

const ALL = MOVE === 'allyoucan';

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

// All you can take: every creature on the board gains IP (the item's resolution grants it to every token)

const CREW = [];

if (ALL) {

const seen = new Set([caster.id]); const disp = Number(caster.document && caster.document.disposition) || 0; const list = [];

for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (!t || !t.actor || seen.has(t.id) || !t.visible || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; seen.add(t.id); list.push(t); }

list.sort((a, b) => ((Number(a.document.disposition) === disp) ? 1 : 0) - ((Number(b.document.disposition) === disp) ? 1 : 0));

list.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 'c' + i; CREW.push({ k, token: t }); if (!tokens[k]) tokens[k] = { token: t }; });

CREW.push({ k: 'k', token: caster });

}

if (!ALL && !FOES.length) { readyHook(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const A_IMG = A.images || {};

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A_IMG, live: true, depthRef: 'k' });

await tl.load();

const T = [];

const RK = RKit(tl, T);

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = RK.KP, m = RK.m, rnd = RK.rnd;

const CL = A.clips || {};

const K = TOK.k, kf = feet(K);

const center = (k) => { const Tk = TOK[k], f = feet(Tk); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - Tk.h * 0.5 }; };

const DIR = FOES.length ? (feet(TOK[FOES[0]]).x >= kf.x ? 1 : -1) : (() => { const o = CREW.find((c) => c.k !== 'k' && Number(c.token.document.disposition) !== Number(caster.document.disposition)); return o && feet(TOK[o.k]).x < kf.x ? -1 : 1; })();

const D2R = Math.PI / 180;

// a mockup lean (deg, positive = toward the party) as a canvas rotation

const lean = (deg) => deg * DIR * D2R;

const clipW = (key, scale) => CL[key].w * scale * 0.55 * KP;

// keyframed value: keys [{ t0, ms, to, ease }] run back to back from 0

const curve = (keys, t) => { let v = 0; for (const q of keys) { if (t < q.t0) break; v = lerp(v, q.to, (q.ease || E.outQ)(seg(t, q.t0, q.t0 + q.ms))); } return v; };

let total = 0, gate = 0, poseAt = null;

if (MOVE === 'greataxe') {

// ── Great Axe: dash, overhead swing, hit, two coins to him, back ──

const tk = FOES[0], tf = feet(TOK[tk]), c = center(tk);

const DEST = { x: tf.x - DIR * cfg.gap * KP * tl.depthRatio(kf, tf), y: tf.y };

const D = cfg.dash, WIND = D + cfg.wind, CUT = WIND + cfg.swing, STEAL = CUT + cfg.hitstop, GATE = STEAL + cfg.coinMs, SETTLE = GATE + cfg.settle, HOME = SETTLE + cfg.home;

const TAG = "[CL-RES][IP-DRAIN-2]";

return;

}

const userActor = await context.helpers.getAttackerActor();

if (!userActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing user actor.");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found.");

return;

}

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args?.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

const escapeHTML = foundry?.utils?.escapeHTML ?? ((v) => String(v ?? ""));

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= targetDef;

};

const getUserTokenName = () => {

if (typeof _token !== "undefined" && _token?.name) return _token.name;

return userActor?.name ?? "User";

};

const getTargetDisplayName = (targetDoc, targetActor) => {

return targetDoc?.name ?? targetActor?.name ?? "Target";

};

async function postStealFeedbackHtml(innerHtml) {

const FLAG_SCOPE = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const FLAG_KEY = "oniHideChatHeader";

let hookId = null;

hookId = Hooks.on("renderChatMessage", (message, html) => {

if (!message?.getFlag?.(FLAG_SCOPE, FLAG_KEY)) return;

html.find(".message-header").remove();

html.find(".message-sender").remove();

html.find(".message-metadata").remove();

html.find(".message-avatar").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-container").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-message-portrait").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-image").remove();

html.find("img.chat-portrait").remove();

Hooks.off("renderChatMessage", hookId);

});

await ChatMessage.create({

user: game.user.id,

type: CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPES.OTHER,

speaker: { alias: "" },

content: `

${innerHtml}

`,

flags: {

[FLAG_SCOPE]: {

[FLAG_KEY]: true

}

}

});

}

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const userTokenName = getUserTokenName();

const targetName = getTargetDisplayName(targetDoc, targetActor);

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

const hit = isHit(targetUuid, targetActor);

console.log(TAG, "HIT CHECK", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

accTotal,

hasAccuracy,

autoHit,

targetDef,

hit

});

if (!hit) {

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(targetActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userMaxIp = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.max_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const requestedSteal = 2;

// The steal amount depends only on the target's current IP.

// Even if the user is already at max IP, the target still loses IP.

const actualSteal = Math.min(requestedSteal, targetIpBefore);

if (actualSteal <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No IP stolen", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

targetIpBefore,

userIpBefore,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpAfter = Math.max(0, targetIpBefore - actualSteal);

// User gain is clamped by max IP, but does not affect the steal amount.

const actualGain = Math.min(actualSteal, Math.max(0, userMaxIp - userIpBefore));

const userIpAfter = Math.min(userMaxIp, userIpBefore + actualGain);

await targetActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(targetIpAfter)

});

await userActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(userIpAfter)

});

console.log(TAG, "IP TRANSFER APPLIED", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

actualSteal,

actualGain,

targetIpBefore,

targetIpAfter,

userIpBefore,

userIpAfter,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(

`${escapeHTML(userTokenName)} steals ${escapeHTML(actualSteal)} IP from ${escapeHTML(targetName)}!`

);

}

const TAG = "[PASSIVE-ACTION][Bandit Trigger]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return context.skipPassive("Bandit Trigger: missing payload.", { notify: false });

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

// --------------------------------------------------

// 1. Confirm this passive was fired by

// "Whenever a creature performs an action"

// --------------------------------------------------

const phase =

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload ??

{};

const triggerKey =

p?.meta?.passiveTriggerKey ??

p?.reaction_trigger_key ??

phase?.trigger ??

"";

if (triggerKey && triggerKey !== "creature_performs_action") {

return context.skipPassive("", { notify: false });

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 2. Check whether the triggering action is an Attack

// --------------------------------------------------

const norm = (v) => String(v ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const actionContext = phase?.actionContext ?? {};

const actionTypeCandidates = [

phase?.sourceType,

phase?.listType,

phase?.skillTypeRaw,

phase?.skill_type,

actionContext?.meta?.sourceType,

actionContext?.meta?.listType,

actionContext?.meta?.skillTypeRaw,

actionContext?.core?.skillTypeRaw,

actionContext?.dataCore?.skillTypeRaw,

actionContext?.dataCore?.listType,

p?.meta?.sourceType,

p?.meta?.listType,

p?.meta?.skillTypeRaw,

p?.core?.skillTypeRaw,

p?.dataCore?.skillTypeRaw,

p?.dataCore?.listType

].map(norm).filter(Boolean);

const isAttack = actionTypeCandidates.includes("attack");

if (!isAttack) {

context.log(`${TAG} skipped: triggering action is not Attack.`, {

actionTypeCandidates

});

return context.skipPassive("", { notify: false });

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 3. Resolve target

// Priority:

// - triggering action targets from reaction payload

// - current passive payload targets

// - helper fallback

// --------------------------------------------------

const targetUuids = [

...(Array.isArray(phase?.targets) ? phase.targets : []),

...(Array.isArray(actionContext?.originalTargetUUIDs) ? actionContext.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(actionContext?.targets) ? actionContext.targets : []),

...(Array.isArray(p?.originalTargetUUIDs) ? p.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(p?.targets) ? p.targets : [])

].filter(Boolean).map(String);

const uniqueTargetUuids = [...new Set(targetUuids)];

let targetActor = null;

let targetDoc = null;

if (uniqueTargetUuids.length) {

targetDoc = await fromUuid(uniqueTargetUuids[0]).catch(() => null);

targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

}

if (!targetActor && context.helpers?.getFirstTargetActor) {

targetActor = await context.helpers.getFirstTargetActor();

}

if (!targetActor) {

context.warn(`${TAG} skipped: no target actor found.`, {

phaseTargets: phase?.targets,

payloadTargets: p?.targets

});

return context.skipPassive("", { notify: false });

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 4. Read target IP and calculate bonus

// Formula: (target IP * 10) / 5

// Simplifies to target IP * 2

// --------------------------------------------------

const props = targetActor.system?.props ?? {};

const targetIP = Math.max(0, Number(props.current_ip ?? props.ip ?? 0) || 0);

const bonusDamage = Math.floor((targetIP * 10) / 5);

if (bonusDamage <= 0) {

context.log(`${TAG} skipped: target has no IP.`, {

target: targetActor.name,

targetIP

});

return context.skipPassive("", { notify: false });

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 5. Add bonus damage to the action damage

// --------------------------------------------------

const beforeBonus = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = beforeBonus + bonusDamage;

p.meta.banditTrigger = {

applied: true,

targetName: targetActor.name,

targetIP,

formula: `(${targetIP} * 10) / 5`,

bonusDamage,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

};

context.log(`${TAG} applied.`, p.meta.banditTrigger);

// a thrown thing (fly): from -> to over ms, arc = mockup px up at mid-flight (negative dips), spin rad per 60 fps frame

K.fly = (at, from, to, o) => { const ms = o.ms; K.add({ t0: at, life: ms, z: o.z == null ? 40 : o.z, draw: (g, u, age) => { const e = (o.ease || E.lin)(Math.min(1, age / ms)); const x = lerp(from().x, to().x, e), y = lerp(from().y, to().y, e) - o.arc * KP * Math.sin(Math.PI * e);

g.translate(x, y); if (o.spin) g.rotate(o.spin * age / 16.67); o.draw(g, age); } }); };

// afterimage: a pale copy of a timeline token's art at its painted spot, fading over ms

K.ghost = (at, k, pose, o) => { o = o || {}; const art = tl.art(k), Tk = tl.TOK[k]; if (!art || !Tk) return; const ms = o.ms || 380, a0 = o.opacity || 0.5;

K.add({ t0: at, life: ms, z: 4, draw: (g, u) => { const f = tl.feet(Tk); g.translate(Tk.x + pose.dx, f.y + pose.dy - (pose.air || 0)); if (pose.rot) g.rotate(pose.rot); g.scale(Tk.flip * (pose.sx || 1), pose.sy || 1); g.globalAlpha = a0 * (1 - u); g.filter = 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)'; g.drawImage(art, -Tk.w / 2, -Tk.h * Tk.foot, Tk.w, Tk.h); } }); };

// the drawn height of a bandit art in the game: a 1x1 token box ("contain") times its texture scale, times the depth there

K.banditH = (img, sc, ds) => { const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; return nh * Math.min(tl.GRID / nw, tl.GRID / nh) * sc * ds; };

// where a body standing on a 2D floor point is drawn, and how big ({ x, y, s })

// cfg.flat (full-takeover shots: the 3D stage flattens) = the 2D point itself, sized by the depth-map factor only

K.floor = (x, y) => { try { const d = oni.depthAt({ x, y }); if (cfg.flat) return { x, y, s: d && Number.isFinite(d.f) && d.f > 0 ? d.f : 1 }; if (d && Number.isFinite(d.s) && d.s > 0) return d; } catch (e) {} return { x, y, s: 1 }; };

// the board edges in world px right now (live board: the real camera)

K.edges = () => { try { const v = tl.camView(tl.makeState()); return { left: v.left, right: v.right, top: v.top, bottom: v.bottom }; } catch (e) { return { left: tl.STAGE.x, right: tl.STAGE.x + tl.STAGE.w, top: tl.STAGE.y, bottom: tl.STAGE.y + tl.STAGE.h }; } };

// a bandit sprite running across the board: img, dir (+1 = to the right), x0 -> x1, row y, h, ms, ease,

// bob(u) mockup px up, rot(u) deg, fade-in ms, z; trail = puff spacing ms (0 = none)

K.runner = (at, o) => { const img = o.img; if (!img) return; const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1, h = o.h, w = h * nw / nh;

K.add({ t0: at, life: o.ms, z: o.z, draw: (g, u0, age) => { const p = pos(age); g.translate(p.x, p.y - (o.bob ? o.bob(p.u) : 0)); if (o.rot) g.rotate(o.rot(p.u) * Math.PI / 180 * o.dir); g.scale(-o.dir, 1);

};

return K;

}

// ── shot ──

// Rauben · Oi! Come help me now! (inner script, every client).

// Port of the approved legacy-boss mockup ("oi" def, part-b3.js): he shouts, each summoned bandit runs in from

// off-screen behind him and hops on arrival. The summon itself is the shipped logic and runs in the OUTER script

// (acting client): it creates the tokens hidden, adds them to the combat, and reveals each one when this shot

// lands it (cfg.t.reveal). Here the real (still hidden) tokens are painted while they run in; each stays painted

// until its token is revealed, so there is no gap and no double. LIVE board, camera untouched. No backticks.

// mockup's loudness, a world-space particle field (dust, coins, twinkles), the afterimage ghost,

// the coin and the thrown axe shapes, depth-scaled bandit runners and the battler size of a bandit.

// Mockup px are on a 1682 px stage; KP scales them to the scene. No backticks, no dollar-brace.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

const VOL = (cfg.volume == null ? 1 : cfg.volume) * 0.75; // mockup sfx(key, v) plays at v * 0.75

const readyHook = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

function RKit(tl, T) {

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const m = tl.mk(T);

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 7331);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const pick = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(R() * arr.length)];

const K = { KP, m, R, rnd, pick, E, seg, lerp };

// the screen px of one mockup stage px (shakes are screen space)

K.SH = () => { try { return tl.view().H / 788; } catch (e) { return 1; } };

// fire once when the run reaches 'at' (a track stays open so a slow frame cannot skip it)

K.once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (did) return; did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[Rauben] cue threw', e); } } }); };

// a sound cue: key in A.sfx, v = the mockup volume; o = { rate, fadeAfter, fadeMs }

K.snd = (at, key, v, o) => { const url = A.sfx && A.sfx[key]; if (!url) return; K.once(at, () => { try { oni.sfx(url, Object.assign({ volume: Math.min(1, v * VOL) }, o || {})); } catch (e) {} }); };

K.shake = (at, ms, px) => { T.push({ t0: at, t1: at + ms, fn: (tt, S) => { S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, px * K.SH() * (1 - tt / ms)); } }); };

K.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2); };

// ── particle field: { t0, life, z, draw(g, u, age) }; z < 5 = under the battlers ──

const P = []; K.P = P;

K.add = (p) => { P.push(p); return p; };

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => {

if (!P.length) return;

const zs = {};

for (let i = P.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = P[i]; if (t >= p.t0 + p.life) { P.splice(i, 1); continue; } if (t < p.t0 || p.dead) continue; (zs[p.z] = zs[p.z] || []).push(p); }

for (const z in zs) { const list = zs[z]; S.world.push({ z: Number(z), draw: (g) => { for (const p of list) { const age = t - p.t0; g.save(); try { p.draw(g, age / p.life, age); } catch (e) {} g.restore(); } } }); }

});

// dust puffs (dustBurst): n puffs thrown up and out from a floor point, drag .97 per frame

K.dust = (at, pt, n, s, rgb, z) => { rgb = rgb || '190,170,140'; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(Math.PI, Math.PI * 2), sp = rnd(0.08, 0.25) * s * KP, vy = rnd(0.02, 0.1) * s * KP, x0 = pt.x + rnd(-10, 10) * s * KP, r = rnd(8, 18) * s * KP;

K.add({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), z: z == null ? 4 : z, draw: (g, u, age) => { const k = (1 - Math.pow(0.97, age / 16.67)) / 0.03 * 16.67; const x = x0 + Math.cos(an) * sp * k, y = pt.y + Math.sin(an) * vy * k; g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.45 * (1 - u)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r * (1 + u), 0, 7); g.fill(); } }); } };

// one drifting puff (a runner's trail)

K.puff = (at, x, y, vx, vy, life, rr, rgb, a0, grow, z) => K.add({ t0: at, life, z, draw: (g, u, age) => { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (a0 * (1 - u)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + vx * age, y + vy * age, rr * (1 + u * grow), 0, 7); g.fill(); } });

// gold twinkles (twinkles)

K.twinkles = (at, pt, n, r, rgb) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = pt.x + rnd(-r, r) * KP, y = pt.y + rnd(-r, r) * 0.8 * KP, s = rnd(5, 11) * KP;

K.add({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), z: 42, draw: (g, u) => { const k = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * s; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; K.glow(g, x, y, k * 2.5, rgb, 0.7); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; g.fillStyle = '#fff';

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y - k * 1.6); g.lineTo(x + k * 0.3, y); g.lineTo(x, y + k * 1.6); g.lineTo(x - k * 0.3, y); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - k * 1.6, y); g.lineTo(x, y + k * 0.3); g.lineTo(x + k * 1.6, y); g.lineTo(x, y - k * 0.3); g.closePath(); g.fill(); } }); } };

// shapes (SHAPE.coin / SHAPE.axe), drawn at the origin

K.coin = (g, age, r) => { const k = Math.abs(Math.cos(age / 70)); g.fillStyle = '#e8b32a'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(0, 0, r * Math.max(0.15, k), r, 0, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#fff3b0'; g.fillRect(-1 * KP, -r * 0.6, 2 * KP, r * 0.5); };

K.axe = (g, s) => { g.scale(s, s); g.strokeStyle = '#4a2f1c'; g.lineWidth = 6; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-30, 0); g.lineTo(30, 0); g.stroke();

g.fillStyle = '#c9ced6'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(18, -4); g.quadraticCurveTo(44, -30, 36, -36); g.quadraticCurveTo(54, -6, 40, 22); g.quadraticCurveTo(40, 6, 18, 4); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.strokeStyle = '#7d1c1c'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke(); };

// a thrown thing (fly): from -> to over ms, arc = mockup px up at mid-flight (negative dips), spin rad per 60 fps frame

K.fly = (at, from, to, o) => { const ms = o.ms; K.add({ t0: at, life: ms, z: o.z == null ? 40 : o.z, draw: (g, u, age) => { const e = (o.ease || E.lin)(Math.min(1, age / ms)); const x = lerp(from().x, to().x, e), y = lerp(from().y, to().y, e) - o.arc * KP * Math.sin(Math.PI * e);

g.translate(x, y); if (o.spin) g.rotate(o.spin * age / 16.67); o.draw(g, age); } }); };

// afterimage: a pale copy of a timeline token's art at its painted spot, fading over ms

K.ghost = (at, k, pose, o) => { o = o || {}; const art = tl.art(k), Tk = tl.TOK[k]; if (!art || !Tk) return; const ms = o.ms || 380, a0 = o.opacity || 0.5;

K.add({ t0: at, life: ms, z: 4, draw: (g, u) => { const f = tl.feet(Tk); g.translate(Tk.x + pose.dx, f.y + pose.dy - (pose.air || 0)); if (pose.rot) g.rotate(pose.rot); g.scale(Tk.flip * (pose.sx || 1), pose.sy || 1); g.globalAlpha = a0 * (1 - u); g.filter = 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)'; g.drawImage(art, -Tk.w / 2, -Tk.h * Tk.foot, Tk.w, Tk.h); } }); };

// the drawn height of a bandit art in the game: a 1x1 token box ("contain") times its texture scale, times the depth there

K.banditH = (img, sc, ds) => { const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; return nh * Math.min(tl.GRID / nw, tl.GRID / nh) * sc * ds; };

// where a body standing on a 2D floor point is drawn, and how big ({ x, y, s })

// cfg.flat (full-takeover shots: the 3D stage flattens) = the 2D point itself, sized by the depth-map factor only

K.floor = (x, y) => { try { const d = oni.depthAt({ x, y }); if (cfg.flat) return { x, y, s: d && Number.isFinite(d.f) && d.f > 0 ? d.f : 1 }; if (d && Number.isFinite(d.s) && d.s > 0) return d; } catch (e) {} return { x, y, s: 1 }; };

// the board edges in world px right now (live board: the real camera)

K.edges = () => { try { const v = tl.camView(tl.makeState()); return { left: v.left, right: v.right, top: v.top, bottom: v.bottom }; } catch (e) { return { left: tl.STAGE.x, right: tl.STAGE.x + tl.STAGE.w, top: tl.STAGE.y, bottom: tl.STAGE.y + tl.STAGE.h }; } };

// a bandit sprite running across the board: img, dir (+1 = to the right), x0 -> x1, row y, h, ms, ease,

// bob(u) mockup px up, rot(u) deg, fade-in ms, z; trail = puff spacing ms (0 = none)

K.runner = (at, o) => { const img = o.img; if (!img) return; const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1, h = o.h, w = h * nw / nh;

const pos = (age) => { const u = Math.min(1, age / o.ms), e = (o.ease || E.lin)(u); return { u, x: lerp(o.x0, o.x1, e), y: lerp(o.y, o.y1 == null ? o.y : o.y1, e) }; };

K.add({ t0: at, life: o.ms, z: o.z, draw: (g, u0, age) => { const p = pos(age); g.translate(p.x, p.y - (o.bob ? o.bob(p.u) : 0)); if (o.rot) g.rotate(o.rot(p.u) * Math.PI / 180 * o.dir); g.scale(-o.dir, 1);

g.globalAlpha = o.fade ? Math.min(1, age / o.fade) : 1; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); } });

if (o.trail) for (let a = 0; a < o.ms; a += o.trail) { const p = pos(a); const tr = o.trailSpec(p, w, h); K.puff(at + a, tr.x, tr.y, tr.vx, tr.vy, tr.life, tr.rr, tr.rgb, tr.a0, tr.grow, tr.z == null ? o.z - 1 : tr.z); }

return { w, h };

};

return K;

}

// ── shot ──

// Rauben · Great Axe (+ Great Axe - Counterattack) / Axe Throw / Bandit Raid / All you can take (inner script, every client).

// Port of the approved legacy-boss mockup (part-b3.js, Rauben defs). LIVE board: the camera is never touched,

// only the bodies a beat moves are painted. cfg.move = "greataxe" | "axethrow" | "raid" | "allyoucan".

// Every damage contact cues oni.hit(); the damage gate (oni.fireDone) sits where the mockup marks it.

// Numbers, flinch and HP bar are the game's. No floating text, no backticks in this file.

if (!caster) { readyHook(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const MOVE = cfg.move;

const ALL = MOVE === 'allyoucan';

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

// All you can take: every creature on the board gains IP (the item's resolution grants it to every token)

const CREW = [];

if (ALL) {

const seen = new Set([caster.id]); const disp = Number(caster.document && caster.document.disposition) || 0; const list = [];

for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (!t || !t.actor || seen.has(t.id) || !t.visible || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; seen.add(t.id); list.push(t); }

list.sort((a, b) => ((Number(a.document.disposition) === disp) ? 1 : 0) - ((Number(b.document.disposition) === disp) ? 1 : 0));

list.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 'c' + i; CREW.push({ k, token: t }); if (!tokens[k]) tokens[k] = { token: t }; });

CREW.push({ k: 'k', token: caster });

}

if (!ALL && !FOES.length) { readyHook(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const A_IMG = A.images || {};

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A_IMG, live: true, depthRef: 'k' });

await tl.load();

const T = [];

const RK = RKit(tl, T);

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = RK.KP, m = RK.m, rnd = RK.rnd;

const CL = A.clips || {};

const K = TOK.k, kf = feet(K);

const center = (k) => { const Tk = TOK[k], f = feet(Tk); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - Tk.h * 0.5 }; };

const DIR = FOES.length ? (feet(TOK[FOES[0]]).x >= kf.x ? 1 : -1) : (() => { const o = CREW.find((c) => c.k !== 'k' && Number(c.token.document.disposition) !== Number(caster.document.disposition)); return o && feet(TOK[o.k]).x < kf.x ? -1 : 1; })();

const D2R = Math.PI / 180;

// a mockup lean (deg, positive = toward the party) as a canvas rotation

const lean = (deg) => deg * DIR * D2R;

const clipW = (key, scale) => CL[key].w * scale * 0.55 * KP;

// keyframed value: keys [{ t0, ms, to, ease }] run back to back from 0

const curve = (keys, t) => { let v = 0; for (const q of keys) { if (t < q.t0) break; v = lerp(v, q.to, (q.ease || E.outQ)(seg(t, q.t0, q.t0 + q.ms))); } return v; };

let total = 0, gate = 0, poseAt = null;

if (MOVE === 'greataxe') {

// ── Great Axe: dash, overhead swing, hit, two coins to him, back ──

const tk = FOES[0], tf = feet(TOK[tk]), c = center(tk);

const DEST = { x: tf.x - DIR * cfg.gap * KP * tl.depthRatio(kf, tf), y: tf.y };

const D = cfg.dash, WIND = D + cfg.wind, CUT = WIND + cfg.swing, STEAL = CUT + cfg.hitstop, GATE = STEAL + cfg.coinMs, SETTLE = GATE + cfg.settle, HOME = SETTLE + cfg.home;

total = HOME + 300; gate = GATE;

const rotKeys = [{ t0: D, ms: cfg.wind, to: -16 }, { t0: WIND, ms: cfg.swing, to: 16 }, { t0: GATE, ms: cfg.settle, to: 0 }];

poseAt = (t) => { let x = kf.x, y = kf.y, air = 0;

if (t < D) { const u = E.ioQ(seg(t, 0, D)); x = lerp(kf.x, DEST.x, u); y = lerp(kf.y, DEST.y, u); }

else if (t < SETTLE) { x = DEST.x; y = DEST.y; }

else { const u = E.ioQ(seg(t, SETTLE, HOME)); x = lerp(DEST.x, kf.x, u); y = lerp(DEST.y, kf.y, u); air = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * cfg.hop * KP; }

return { dx: x - kf.x, dy: y - kf.y, air, rot: lean(curve(rotKeys, t)), sx: 1, sy: 1 }; };

// the dash leaves three afterimages (trail .3 of the eased move)

for (const e of [0.3, 0.6, 0.9]) { const u = e < 0.5 ? Math.sqrt(e / 2) : 1 - Math.sqrt((1 - e) / 2); const at = Math.round(u * D) + 1; RK.ghost(at, 'k', poseAt(at)); }

RK.snd(WIND, 'swingF', 0.55);

m.clip('slash3', CUT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('slash3', 1.2), z: 40 });

RK.once(CUT, () => oni.hit());

RK.snd(CUT, 'blowL', 0.6); RK.shake(CUT, 260, 10);

RK.snd(STEAL, 'steal', 0.45); RK.snd(STEAL, 'coin', 0.45);

// coinsTo: two coins hop from the target to him (resolves when the first lands = the gate)

const to = () => ({ x: DEST.x, y: DEST.y - K.h * tl.depthRatio(kf, DEST) * 0.5 });

for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { const ox = rnd(-12, 12) * KP, arc = rnd(70, 130); RK.fly(STEAL + i * 70, () => ({ x: c.x + ox, y: c.y }), to, { ms: cfg.coinMs, arc, ease: E.sine, z: 41, draw: (g, age) => RK.coin(g, age, 7 * KP) }); }

}

if (MOVE === 'axethrow') {

// ── Axe Throw: a spinning axe flies out, hits, and arcs back into his hand ──

const tk = FOES[0], c = center(tk);

const hand = () => ({ x: kf.x + DIR * K.w * 0.3, y: kf.y - K.h * 0.62 });

const W1 = cfg.wind, HIT = W1 + cfg.out, BACK = HIT + cfg.back, SQ = BACK + 90, SQ2 = SQ + 120, END = SQ2 + 140;

const rotKeys = [{ t0: 0, ms: cfg.wind, to: -12 }, { t0: W1, ms: 100, to: 10 }, { t0: SQ2, ms: 140, to: 0 }];

RK.fly(W1, hand, () => c, { ms: cfg.out, arc: 60, spin: 0.35, z: 40, draw: (g) => RK.axe(g, 1.1 * KP) });

m.clip('slash', HIT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('slash', 1), z: 41 });

RK.once(HIT, () => oni.hit());

RK.snd(HIT, 'blowL', 0.5); RK.snd(HIT, 'swingA', 0.4);

RK.fly(HIT, () => c, hand, { ms: cfg.back, arc: -70, spin: 0.35, z: 40, draw: (g) => RK.axe(g, 1.1 * KP) });

}

if (MOVE === 'raid') {

// ── Bandit Raid: he whistles; three bandits dash through the target from off-screen, one hit at the end ──

const tk = FOES[0], tf = feet(TOK[tk]), c = center(tk);

const W0 = 160, WEND = W0 + 300 + 160, RUN = WEND;

const LAST = RUN + 2 * cfg.stagger + cfg.runMs;

total = LAST + 400; gate = LAST;

const rotKeys = [{ t0: 0, ms: 160, to: 6 }, { t0: W0 + 300, ms: 160, to: 0 }];

poseAt = (t) => ({ dx: 0, dy: 0, air: 0, rot: lean(curve(rotKeys, t)), sx: 1, sy: 1 });

RK.snd(W0, 'item', 0.4);

const ed = RK.edges();

const x0 = (DIR > 0 ? ed.left : ed.right) - DIR * 120 * KP, x1 = (DIR > 0 ? ed.right : ed.left) + DIR * 218 * KP;

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

const art = RK.pick(cfg.bandits), img = tl.IMG[art]; if (!img) continue;

const y = tf.y + (i - 1) * 18 * KP, h = RK.banditH(img, cfg.bsc[art] || 1.34, tl.depthS(tf.x, y)), z = y < tf.y ? 3 : 30;

RK.runner(RUN + i * cfg.stagger, { img, dir: DIR, x0, x1, y, h, ms: cfg.runMs, ease: E.lin, z,

bob: (u) => Math.abs(Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 9)) * 8 * KP, rot: (u) => Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 9) * 4,

trail: 64, trailSpec: (p) => ({ x: p.x - DIR * 20 * KP, y: p.y, vx: -0.05 * DIR * KP, vy: -0.02 * KP, life: 500, rr: rnd(5, 10) * KP, rgb: '190,170,140', a0: 0.4, grow: 1 }) });

}

m.clip('hit', LAST, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('hit', 1), z: 41 });

RK.once(LAST, () => oni.hit());

RK.snd(LAST, 'blowL', 0.5);

}

if (MOVE === 'allyoucan') {

poseAt = (t) => { let x = kf.x; if (t < BACK) x = lerp(kf.x, DEST.x, E.sine(seg(t, 0, STEP))); else x = lerp(DEST.x, kf.x, E.ioQ(seg(t, BACK, HOME))); return { dx: x - kf.x, dy: 0, air: 0, rot: 0, sx: 1, sy: 1 }; };

m.hold(0, total, (t, S) => { const a = t < BACK ? 0.45 * E.sine(seg(t, 0, 400)) : 0.45 * (1 - E.sine(seg(t, BACK, BACK + 400))); S.dim = Math.max(S.dim, a); });

RK.snd(SHOWER, 'coin', 0.5);

const ipGain = (actor) => { const p = (actor && actor.system && actor.system.props) || {}; let cur = Number(p.current_ip), max = Number(p.max_ip);

if (!('current_ip' in p) || !('max_ip' in p)) { const s = (actor && actor.system) || {}; cur = Number(s.current_ip); max = Number(s.max_ip); }

if (!Number.isFinite(cur) || !Number.isFinite(max)) return 0; return Math.max(0, Math.min(max, cur + cfg.gain) - cur); };

const bdNumbers = () => { try { return globalThis.FUCompanion.api.experimental.battleDirector.damageNumbers; } catch (e) { return null; } };

CREW.forEach((cr, i) => {

const at = SHOWER + i * 70, Tk = TOK[cr.k]; if (!Tk) return;

const home = () => { const f = feet(Tk); const dx = cr.k === 'k' ? DEST.x - kf.x : 0; return { x: f.x + dx, y: f.y - Tk.h * 0.5 }; };

for (let n = 0; n < 5; n++) { const ox = rnd(-30, 30) * KP, tx = rnd(-20, 20) * KP;

RK.fly(at, () => ({ x: home().x + ox, y: RK.edges().top - 40 * KP }), () => ({ x: home().x + tx, y: home().y }), { ms: 520 + n * 40, arc: 0, ease: E.inQ, z: 41, draw: (g, age) => RK.coin(g, age, 7 * KP) }); }

RK.snd(at + ARRIVE, 'coin', 0.25);

RK.twinkles(at + ARRIVE, home(), 3, 24, '255,220,120');

if (amount > 0 && uuid) RK.once(at + ARRIVE, () => { const dn = bdNumbers(); if (dn && dn.renderLocal) dn.renderLocal({ kind: 'gain', tokenUuid: uuid, resource: 'ip', amount }); });

});

}

m.hold(0, total, (t, S) => { if (!poseAt) return; const p = poseAt(t), d = S.tok.k; d.dx = p.dx; d.dy = p.dy; d.air = p.air; d.rot = p.rot; d.sx = p.sx; d.sy = p.sy; });

RK.once(gate, () => oni.fireDone());

await tl.run(T, { total, onStart: readyHook });

oni.fireDone();

const GAIN_IP = 6;

const tokens = Array.from(canvas?.tokens?.placeables ?? []);

function getIpInfo(actor) {

const hasProps = !!actor?.system?.props;

const curPath = hasProps && ("current_ip" in actor.system.props)

? "system.props.current_ip"

: (actor?.system && ("current_ip" in actor.system) ? "system.current_ip" : null);

const maxPath = hasProps && ("max_ip" in actor.system.props)

? "system.props.max_ip"

: (actor?.system && ("max_ip" in actor.system) ? "system.max_ip" : null);

if (!curPath || !maxPath) return null;

const maxRaw = foundry.utils.getProperty(actor, maxPath);

const current = Number(curRaw);

const max = Number(maxRaw);

gain: GAIN_IP,

after: nextIp,

max: ip.max

});

}

applied,

skipped,

gainEach: GAIN_IP

});

K.dust = (at, pt, n, s, rgb, z) => { rgb = rgb || '190,170,140'; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(Math.PI, Math.PI * 2), sp = rnd(0.08, 0.25) * s * KP, vy = rnd(0.02, 0.1) * s * KP, x0 = pt.x + rnd(-10, 10) * s * KP, r = rnd(8, 18) * s * KP;
