};

ZP.stop = (stops, t, col) => { for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) if (t <= stops[i][0]) { const a = stops[i - 1], b = stops[i]; const u = (t - a[0]) / Math.max(1e-6, b[0] - a[0]); const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u); return a[col] + (b[col] - a[col]) * k; } return stops[stops.length - 1][col]; };

// Flinch sample at ms since the hit: { sx, sy, dx, b (brightness) } or null when over.

ZP.flinchAt = (ms, tier) => { const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; if (ms < 0 || ms >= F.ms) return null; const u = ms / F.ms; return { sx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 1), sy: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 2), dx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 3), b: ZP.stop(F.bright, u, 1) }; };

// The hurt reaction on a PAINTED timeline token k at 'at': its hurt art (sprite_hurt,

// the engine's hurt loop) for hurtMs with the flinch on top, else the flinch alone.

// Use with oni.hit({ numbersOnly: true }) so the game's own DOM flinch stays off.

ZP.flinchTok = (m, at, k, tier, hurtMs) => {

const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; const hold = Math.max(F.ms, hurtMs == null ? 700 : hurtMs);

m.hold(at, at + hold, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; q.hurt = true; const f = ZP.flinchAt(e, tier); if (!f) return; q.sx *= f.sx; q.sy *= f.sy; q.dx += f.dx; if (f.b > 1.05) { const a = Math.min(1, (f.b - 1) / 3); if (a > q.tintA) { q.tint = '#ffffff'; q.tintA = a; } } });

};

// Screen anchor for a damage number at screen px (x, y) of the overlay: board-view fractions.

ZP.frac = (g, x, y) => ({ fx: x / g.W, fy: y / g.H });

// Splitting for a drawn pseudo multi-hit preview (bench only; in battle the numbers come from BD).

ZP.split = (total, n) => { const out = []; let prev = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { const c = Math.round(total * i / n); out.push(c - prev); prev = c; } return out; };

// A soft additive glow (canvas 2D).

ZP.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// A deterministic particle field for a track: n particles from seed, each p(i, r) => spec,

// drawn by draw(g, p, e). Lets a whole ember/dust swarm live in one track (no per-frame spawns).

ZP.swarm = (tl, n, seed, make) => { const r = tl.rng(seed || 3); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(make(i, r)); return out; };

// A glow-sprite with a black backing turned into real alpha (alpha = brightness), cached.

ZP._ga = new Map();

ZP.glowAlpha = (img) => { if (!img) return null; if (ZP._ga.has(img)) return ZP._ga.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; if (!w || !h) return null; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

try { const id = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h), d = id.data; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { const mx = Math.max(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]); if (mx > 0) { d[i] = d[i] * 255 / mx; d[i + 1] = d[i + 1] * 255 / mx; d[i + 2] = d[i + 2] * 255 / mx; } d[i + 3] = mx; } x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); } catch (e) { return img; }

ZP._ga.set(img, cv); return cv; };

// Tip and joint of a Disgaea weapon part, read from its alpha (top-most / bottom-most opaque rows).

ZP._li = new Map();

ZP.limbInfo = (img) => { if (ZP._li.has(img)) return ZP._li.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); let d; try { d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; } catch (e) { const r0 = { tip: { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r0); return r0; }

const row = (y) => { let a = -1, b = -1; for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 90) { if (a < 0) a = i; b = i; } return a < 0 ? null : (a + b) / 2; };

let tip = null, joint = null; for (let y = 0; y < h && !tip; y++) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) tip = { x: c, y }; } for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0 && !joint; y--) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) joint = { x: c, y }; }

const r = { tip: tip || { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: joint || { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r); return r; };

// ── shot ──

// Rauben · Zero Power: Night of Hundred Bandits (inner script, every client).

// Port of the shipped script as the legacy-boss mockup re-tuned it (part-b3.js "hundred" + part-r3 / r4 / r5 / r7):

// the shipped Zero Power cut-in over a .55 dim, Rauben turns to his gang and throws a tantrum, then a 9 s stampede

// of bandits pours across the WHOLE floor (far rows small, near rows big) in dust and smoke while every PC holds

// its hurt pose and flinches non-stop; the final Berserker stomps up and stops in front of the party, leaps, trips

// in the air, the screen whites out right before he lands, the slam is heard in the white, the white holds, the

// gate fires, the white lifts. FULL TAKEOVER (not the live board): the shot drives the camera, so the 2.1x zoom into

// the slam plays, and the camera snaps back to rest while the screen is still white (r7). No fist hit VFX

// (removed in review). No backticks in this file.

if (!caster || !targets.length) { readyHook(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const PARTY = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; PARTY.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: {}, images: A.images || {} });

await tl.load();

const T = [];

const RK = RKit(tl, T);

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = RK.KP, m = RK.m, rnd = RK.rnd, R = RK.R;

const C = cfg.t;

const K = TOK.k, kf = feet(K);

const PF = PARTY.map((k) => feet(TOK[k]));

const PC = { x: PF.reduce((s, f) => s + f.x, 0) / PF.length, y: PF.reduce((s, f) => s + f.y, 0) / PF.length };

const DIR = PC.x >= kf.x ? 1 : -1;

const NEAR = DIR > 0 ? Math.min(...PF.map((f) => f.x)) : Math.max(...PF.map((f) => f.x));

const IMP = { x: PC.x, y: PC.y }; // the slam lands in the middle of the party

const ed = RK.edges();

const BACK_EDGE = DIR > 0 ? ed.left : ed.right, FRONT_EDGE = DIR > 0 ? ed.right : ed.left;

const ST = C.stampede, DUR = cfg.stampedeMs, SLAM = C.slam, CLEAR = SLAM + cfg.jumpMs + 60, GATE = CLEAR + cfg.whiteHold;

// ── the smoke cloud clip, decoded once and tinted (sepia .7, brightness .85) in the background ──

let SMOKE = null;

(async () => { try { const d = await tl.decode(A.smoke.url, { fps: 15 }); const fr = d.frames.map((f) => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = f.width; c.height = f.height; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.filter = 'sepia(.7) brightness(.85)'; x.drawImage(f, 0, 0); return c; }); SMOKE = { frames: fr, dur: A.smoke.dur }; } catch (e) { SMOKE = null; } })();

// ── cut-in + dim (the dim sits under the battlers) ──

ZP.cutin(tl, m, 0, 'cut');

RK.snd(0, 'overdrive', 0.9);

m.hold(0, CLEAR + 10, (t, S) => { const a = t < CLEAR ? cfg.dim * E.sine(seg(t, 0, 180)) : cfg.dim * (1 - seg(t, CLEAR, CLEAR + 10)); S.dim = Math.max(S.dim, a); });

// ── Rauben: turns to his gang, tantrum, turns back 500 ms into the stampede ──

const TURN = C.turn, TAN = TURN + cfg.flipMs, TAN_END = TAN + cfg.tantrumMs, BACKF = ST + cfg.waitFlipBack;

m.hold(TURN, BACKF + cfg.flipMs, (tt, S) => { const t = tt + TURN, d = S.tok.k;

if (t < TAN) d.sx = lerp(1, -1, E.ioC(seg(t, TURN, TAN)));

else if (t < BACKF) d.sx = -1;

else d.sx = lerp(-1, 1, E.ioC(seg(t, BACKF, BACKF + cfg.flipMs)));

if (t >= TAN && t < TAN_END) { const e = E.ioC(seg(t, TAN, TAN_END)); d.dx = Math.sin(e * Math.PI * 2 * cfg.cycles) * cfg.ampX * KP; d.air = Math.abs(Math.sin(e * Math.PI * 4)) * cfg.ampY * KP; } });

// ── the stampede ──

RK.snd(ST, 'crowd', 0.45 / 0.75, { fadeAfter: C.crowdFade - ST, fadeMs: cfg.crowdFadeMs });

const ARTS = ['bandit', 'mage', 'berserker', 'archer'];

const MIDX = tl.STAGE.x + tl.STAGE.w / 2;

const every = Math.max(18, cfg.spawnEvery / cfg.density);

for (let at = ST; at < ST + DUR; at += every) {

const art = RK.pick(ARTS), img = tl.IMG[art]; if (!img) continue;

const y01 = rnd(cfg.rowMin, cfg.rowMax), d = RK.floor(MIDX, tl.STAGE.y + y01 * tl.STAGE.h), s = d.s;

const h = RK.banditH(img, cfg.bsc[art] || 1.34, s) * rnd(0.9, 1.1), extra = Math.max(120 * KP, h * 0.5);

const ms = rnd(cfg.runMin, cfg.runMax) * (1.1 - 0.2 * y01);

const z = d.y < IMP.y - 30 * KP ? 3 : 20;

RK.runner(at, { img, dir: DIR, x0: BACK_EDGE - DIR * extra, x1: FRONT_EDGE + DIR * extra, y: d.y, y1: d.y + rnd(-8, 8) * KP, h, ms, ease: E.ioC, fade: 80, z,

bob: (u) => Math.abs(Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 7)) * 6 * s * KP,

trail: 30, trailSpec: (p) => ({ x: p.x - DIR * h * 0.15, y: p.y - 4 * KP, vx: -DIR * rnd(0.02, 0.08) * KP, vy: -rnd(0.005, 0.03) * KP, life: rnd(500, 900), rr: rnd(6, 14) * s * 1.4 * KP, rgb: '185,165,135', a0: 0.42, grow: 1.4 }) });

}

// rolling smoke clouds over the lane + dust on a party member every 160-300 ms

const CLOUDS = [];

for (let at = ST; at < ST + DUR; at += rnd(160, 300)) {

const y01 = rnd(0.3, 0.95), d = RK.floor(MIDX, tl.STAGE.y + y01 * tl.STAGE.h);

CLOUDS.push({ at, x: rnd(ed.left + 80 * KP, ed.right - 80 * KP), y: d.y, w: 228 * 0.55 * rnd(0.8, 1.4) * d.s * KP });

const k = RK.pick(PARTY), f = feet(TOK[k]); RK.dust(at, f, 5, RK.floor(f.x, f.y).s / RK.floor(kf.x, kf.y).s, null, 24);

}

m.hold(ST, CLEAR, (tt, S) => { if (!SMOKE) return; const t = tt + ST; const live = CLOUDS.filter((c) => t >= c.at && t < c.at + SMOKE.dur); if (!live.length) return;

S.world.push({ z: 25, draw: (g) => { for (const c of live) { const u = (t - c.at) / SMOKE.dur, fr = SMOKE.frames[Math.min(SMOKE.frames.length - 1, Math.floor(u * SMOKE.frames.length))]; if (!fr) continue; const w = c.w, h = w * fr.height / fr.width; g.globalAlpha = 0.55; g.drawImage(fr, c.x - w / 2, c.y - h / 2, w, h); } g.globalAlpha = 1; } }); });

// every PC holds its hurt pose for the whole stampede (one swap in, one swap out) and flinches on every trample

m.hold(ST, ST + DUR, (tt, S) => { for (const k of PARTY) if (S.tok[k]) S.tok[k].hurt = true; });

const flinch = (at, k, tier) => { const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier]; m.hold(at, at + F.ms, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const f = ZP.flinchAt(e, tier); if (!f) return; q.sx *= f.sx; q.sy *= f.sy; q.dx += f.dx * KP; if (f.b > 1.05) { const a = Math.min(1, (f.b - 1) / 3); if (a > q.tintA) { q.tint = '#ffffff'; q.tintA = a; } } }); };

for (let at = ST; at < ST + DUR; at += cfg.bedEvery + rnd(0, cfg.bedJitter)) {

flinch(at, RK.pick(PARTY), R() < 0.3 ? 'strong' : 'normal');

RK.snd(at, 'damage3', 0.1 / 0.75, { rate: rnd(0.95, 1.08) });

}

// the ground rumbles under the stampede

m.hold(ST, C.final, (tt, S) => { S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, cfg.rumble * RK.SH()); });

// ── the final Berserker: four heavy steps up to the front of the party, a pause, the leap + trip ──

const BIMG = tl.IMG.berserker;

const BH = BIMG ? (BIMG.naturalHeight || BIMG.height || 214) * cfg.finalScale * (788 / 1080) * KP : 0;

const BW = BIMG ? BH * (BIMG.naturalWidth || BIMG.width || 1) / (BIMG.naturalHeight || BIMG.height || 1) : 0;

const BY = IMP.y + cfg.finalYOff * KP;

const BX0 = BACK_EDGE - DIR * 303 * KP, BSTOP = NEAR - DIR * cfg.stopGap * KP, STEP = (BSTOP - BX0) / cfg.steps;

const FIN = C.final;

const JH = cfg.jumpH * (788 / 1080) * 1.2 * KP;

const bandit = (t) => {

let x = BX0, y = BY, oy = 0, rot = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.steps; i++) { const s0 = FIN + i * (cfg.stepMs + cfg.stepPause); if (t < s0) break; const u = E.ioC(seg(t, s0, s0 + cfg.stepMs)); x = BX0 + STEP * (i + E.ioC(u)); if (t < s0 + cfg.stepMs) oy = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * cfg.stepBob * KP; } // the mockup eases the step twice

if (t >= SLAM) { const e = E.inQ(seg(t, SLAM, SLAM + cfg.jumpMs)); x = lerp(BSTOP, IMP.x - DIR * 40 * KP, e); y = lerp(BY, IMP.y + 10 * KP, e); oy = Math.sin(e * Math.PI) * JH; rot = cfg.fallRot * E.inQ(Math.max(0, (e - 0.5) / 0.5)) * 0.6; }

return { x, y, oy, rot };

};

m.hold(FIN, CLEAR, (tt, S) => { if (!BIMG) return; const p = bandit(tt + FIN);

S.world.push({ z: 46, draw: (g) => { g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y - p.oy); if (p.rot) g.rotate(p.rot * Math.PI / 180 * DIR); g.scale(-DIR, 1); g.drawImage(BIMG, -BW / 2, -BH, BW, BH); g.restore(); } }); });

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.steps; i++) { const at = FIN + i * (cfg.stepMs + cfg.stepPause) + cfg.stepMs;

RK.snd(at, 'downc', 0.35 + i * 0.1); RK.shake(at, 200, 4 + i * 3); RK.dust(at, { x: BX0 + STEP * (i + 1), y: BY }, 8, 1.2, null, 44); }

RK.snd(SLAM, 'jump2', 0.6);

// ── the whiteout comes right before he lands; the slam is heard in the white; hold; gate; the white lifts ──

const W0 = SLAM + Math.round(cfg.jumpMs * Math.sqrt(0.78));

m.hold(W0, GATE + cfg.whiteOut, (tt, S) => { const t = tt + W0; const a = t < GATE ? E.sine(seg(t, W0, W0 + 90)) : 1 - E.ioC(seg(t, GATE, GATE + cfg.whiteOut)); if (a > S.flash.a) S.flash = { a, c: '#ffffff' }; });

RK.snd(CLEAR, 'explosion2', 0.6); RK.snd(CLEAR, 'blowL', 0.7); RK.snd(CLEAR, 'damage4', 0.5);

RK.shake(CLEAR, 500, 24);

RK.once(CLEAR, () => { for (const p of RK.P) p.dead = true; }); // the stampede is gone when the white lifts

// the camera: at rest until the leap, then pushes 2.1x into the impact (in-cubic); back at rest the moment the white is full

const CAM_RESET = W0 + 90;

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => { const z = t >= SLAM && t < CAM_RESET ? E.inC(seg(t, SLAM, SLAM + cfg.zoomMs)) : 0;

S.cam = { cx: lerp(tl.REST.cx, IMP.x, z), cy: lerp(tl.REST.cy, IMP.y - cfg.zoomLift * KP, z), zoom: lerp(1, cfg.zoom, z) }; });

RK.once(GATE, () => { oni.hit(); oni.fireDone(); });

const total = GATE + cfg.whiteOut + 900;

await tl.run(T, { total, onStart: readyHook });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 30260);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Zero Power: Night of Hundred Bandits" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][NightOfHundredBandit]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

return;

}

const DAMAGE_X = 10; // tuning knob

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const targetCount = Math.max(1, targetUuids.length);

// Count IP from ALL visible creature tokens in the scene

const countedTokens = (canvas?.tokens?.placeables ?? []).filter(tok => {

return !!tok?.actor && tok?.document?.hidden !== true;

});

let totalSceneIp = 0;

for (const tok of countedTokens) {

const ip = Number(tok?.actor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? 0) || 0;

totalSceneIp += Math.max(0, ip);

}

const bonusDamage = Math.floor((totalSceneIp * DAMAGE_X) / targetCount);

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const beforeBonus = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = beforeBonus + bonusDamage;

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.meta.nightHundredBandit = {

damageX: DAMAGE_X,

totalSceneIp,

targetCount,

computedBonusDamage: bonusDamage,

countedTokens: countedTokens.map(t => ({

name: t.name,

uuid: t.document?.uuid ?? "",

ip: Number(t?.actor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? 0) || 0

}))

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

totalSceneIp,

targetCount,

damageX: DAMAGE_X,

bonusDamage,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});

// Cleaving Strike — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

(async () => {

const CFG = {"move":"cleave","casterFoot":0.95,"partyFoot":0.97,"seed":2525,"volume":0.75,"totalTimeoutMs":15000};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"ggslash":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/Guilty%20Gear%20Strive/webm/slashanim01.webm","w":512,"h":682,"dur":600,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5,"k":0.55,"add":true},"slash_phys":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/006_slash_physical.webm","w":378,"h":378,"dur":333,"ax":0.4683,"ay":0.5794,"k":0.55,"add":false}},"sfx":{"swingF":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_SWINGF.wav","slash1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Slash1.ogg","slash2":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Slash2.ogg"},"images":{}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-rauben-cleaving-strike";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Cleaving Strike]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

// A Chain tick: reveals the next strike (number, HP bar, counter) on the acting GM.

// info: { numbersOnly, screenAt: { [tokenUuid]: { fx, fy } } } or a function returning it.

// paced: every Zero Power cues each strike itself, so the presenter never fills a gap with its own beat.

ZP.hit = (m, at, info) => ZP.once(m, at, () => oni.hit(Object.assign({ paced: true }, typeof info === 'function' ? info() : (info || {}))));

// The shipped Zero Power cut-in (createCutinDOM/runCutinDOM): a full-body image

// 92% of the view tall on the bottom edge; left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out, 650 ms),

// hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in, 650 ms). Drawn in screen space above the board.

// Needs A.images[key]; Overdrive is a cfg sfx cue at the same time.

ZP.cssOut = (t) => ZP.bez(0, 0, 0.58, 1, t);

ZP.cssIn = (t) => ZP.bez(0.42, 0, 1, 1, t);

ZP.bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const fx = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= fx / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

ZP.cutin = (tl, m, at, key, o) => {

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => { const img = tl.IMG[key]; if (!img) return; (o.over ? S.over : S.screen).push({ draw: (g) => {

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

const x = e < inMs ? -1.2 * g.W * (1 - ZP.cssOut(e / inMs)) : e < inMs + hold ? 0 : 1.2 * g.W * ZP.cssIn((e - inMs - hold) / outMs);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

return at + end;

};

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

// Crysta next to the drawn one). keep: extra tokens to leave alone.

ZP.bystanders = (keep) => {

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

let n = 0; for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; out['b' + (n++)] = { token: t }; }

return out;

};

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

ZP.focus = (m, TOK, at, ms, back, backMs) => {

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

for (const k of keys) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / ms; else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / backMs); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } });

return keys;

};

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

ZP.FLINCH = {

normal: { ms: 300, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.12, 1.12, 0.88, 0], [0.30, 0.97, 1.03, -7], [0.50, 1, 1, 6], [0.70, 1, 1, -4], [0.85, 1, 1, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 3.6], [0.35, 1], [1, 1]] },

strong: { ms: 480, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.10, 1.22, 0.80, 0], [0.26, 0.90, 1.10, -13], [0.44, 1, 1, 11], [0.62, 1, 1, -7], [0.80, 1, 1, 5], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 4], [0.20, 1], [0.40, 3.2], [0.60, 1], [1, 1]] },

};

ZP.stop = (stops, t, col) => { for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) if (t <= stops[i][0]) { const a = stops[i - 1], b = stops[i]; const u = (t - a[0]) / Math.max(1e-6, b[0] - a[0]); const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u); return a[col] + (b[col] - a[col]) * k; } return stops[stops.length - 1][col]; };

// Flinch sample at ms since the hit: { sx, sy, dx, b (brightness) } or null when over.

ZP.flinchAt = (ms, tier) => { const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; if (ms < 0 || ms >= F.ms) return null; const u = ms / F.ms; return { sx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 1), sy: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 2), dx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 3), b: ZP.stop(F.bright, u, 1) }; };

// The hurt reaction on a PAINTED timeline token k at 'at': its hurt art (sprite_hurt,

// the engine's hurt loop) for hurtMs with the flinch on top, else the flinch alone.

// Use with oni.hit({ numbersOnly: true }) so the game's own DOM flinch stays off.

ZP.flinchTok = (m, at, k, tier, hurtMs) => {

const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; const hold = Math.max(F.ms, hurtMs == null ? 700 : hurtMs);

m.hold(at, at + hold, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; q.hurt = true; const f = ZP.flinchAt(e, tier); if (!f) return; q.sx *= f.sx; q.sy *= f.sy; q.dx += f.dx; if (f.b > 1.05) { const a = Math.min(1, (f.b - 1) / 3); if (a > q.tintA) { q.tint = '#ffffff'; q.tintA = a; } } });

};

// Screen anchor for a damage number at screen px (x, y) of the overlay: board-view fractions.

ZP.frac = (g, x, y) => ({ fx: x / g.W, fy: y / g.H });

// Splitting for a drawn pseudo multi-hit preview (bench only; in battle the numbers come from BD).

ZP.split = (total, n) => { const out = []; let prev = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { const c = Math.round(total * i / n); out.push(c - prev); prev = c; } return out; };

// A soft additive glow (canvas 2D).

ZP.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// A deterministic particle field for a track: n particles from seed, each p(i, r) => spec,

// drawn by draw(g, p, e). Lets a whole ember/dust swarm live in one track (no per-frame spawns).

ZP.swarm = (tl, n, seed, make) => { const r = tl.rng(seed || 3); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(make(i, r)); return out; };

// A glow-sprite with a black backing turned into real alpha (alpha = brightness), cached.

ZP._ga = new Map();

ZP.glowAlpha = (img) => { if (!img) return null; if (ZP._ga.has(img)) return ZP._ga.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; if (!w || !h) return null; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

try { const id = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h), d = id.data; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { const mx = Math.max(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]); if (mx > 0) { d[i] = d[i] * 255 / mx; d[i + 1] = d[i + 1] * 255 / mx; d[i + 2] = d[i + 2] * 255 / mx; } d[i + 3] = mx; } x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); } catch (e) { return img; }

ZP._ga.set(img, cv); return cv; };

// Tip and joint of a Disgaea weapon part, read from its alpha (top-most / bottom-most opaque rows).

ZP._li = new Map();

ZP.limbInfo = (img) => { if (ZP._li.has(img)) return ZP._li.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); let d; try { d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; } catch (e) { const r0 = { tip: { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r0); return r0; }

const row = (y) => { let a = -1, b = -1; for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 90) { if (a < 0) a = i; b = i; } return a < 0 ? null : (a + b) / 2; };

let tip = null, joint = null; for (let y = 0; y < h && !tip; y++) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) tip = { x: c, y }; } for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0 && !joint; y--) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) joint = { x: c, y }; }

const r = { tip: tip || { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: joint || { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r); return r; };

// ── Legacy twins kit (Jack + Jill, + the shared Mug / Cleaving Strike Rauben also uses) ──────────────

// Prepended (after the Zero Power kit) by legacy-twins-signatures.js. A canvas-2D port of the mockup's

// shared kit ("Legacy boss animations" mockup, part-common.js + the round-3 afterimage / comic puff):

// a keyframed body for the caster, afterimage ghosts, a stepped particle field (ground / field / hit

// layers), projectiles with glow trails, rings, cracks, dust, twinkles, wisps, coins, the impact frame,

// radial speed lines and the pixel-crisp Zero Power cut-in.

// LIVE board: the camera is never touched; only bodies a beat moves are painted. Every mockup number is

// in mockup px on a 1682 px stage and is scaled by KP (stage width / 1682) and the depth ratio.

// Mirroring: the mockup's enemy faces right; every x offset and rotation is multiplied by DIR.

// No backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

const CL = A.clips || {};

// cfg.live false = FULL TAKEOVER (the shot owns the board and drives S.cam: Apex Arrow's push-in); else LIVE board

const LIVE = cfg.live !== false;

const tl = oni.timeline(LIVE ? { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {}, live: true, depthRef: 'k' } : { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {} });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 2525);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (!did) { did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ONI][twins] cue threw', e); } } } }); };

const S_ = (at, url, v) => { if (url) sfx.push({ at: Math.round(at), url, v: v * (cfg.volume == null ? 0.75 : cfg.volume) }); };

const SX = (at, key, v) => S_(at, (A.sfx || {})[key], v);

const DEG = Math.PI / 180;

const K = TOK.k, KF = feet(K);

// facing: toward the first target; with none (a self-cast) the way the caster's art faces

const DIR = FOES.length ? (TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1) : (K.dir || 1);

const DR = (pt) => tl.depthRatio(KF, pt); // size at pt vs the caster's spot

const HB = (k) => TOK[k].h * TOK[k].foot; // body height above the feet

const tFeet = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

const tCenter = (k) => { const f = feet(TOK[k]); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - HB(k) * 0.5 }; };

// a spot in front of a target, on the caster's side (the mockup's front(t, gap))

const front = (k, gap) => { const f = tFeet(k); return { x: f.x - DIR * gap * KP * DR(f), y: f.y }; };

// EASE names as the mockup has them

const EZ = { lin: E.lin, quad: E.ioQ, out: E.outQ, in: E.inQ, outCubic: E.outC, sine: E.sine };

const EOUTBACK = (u) => { const c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1; return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(u - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(u - 1, 2); };

// ── the caster's body: keyframed channels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

// dx / dy (scene px), lift (scene px), rot (deg, the mockup's enemy sign), sx / sy, hop (an arc on top

// of the lift), pivot (0 = feet, 1 = the mockup's 50% 55% spin pivot).

const chan = (v0) => ({ v0, segs: [] });

const valAt = (c, t) => { let v = c.v0; for (const s of c.segs) { if (t < s.t0) break; const u = s.t1 > s.t0 ? Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / (s.t1 - s.t0)) : 1; v = s.fn ? (t >= s.t1 ? s.fn(1) : s.fn(u)) : (t >= s.t1 ? s.to : lerp(s.from, s.to, s.ease(u))); } return v; };

const key = (c, at, ms, to, ease) => { const from = valAt(c, at); c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(0, ms), from, to, ease: ease || E.lin }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const keyFn = (c, at, ms, fn) => { c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(1, ms), fn }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const BODY = { dx: chan(0), dy: chan(0), lift: chan(0), hop: chan(0), rot: chan(0), sx: chan(1), sy: chan(1), pivot: chan(0) };

let BODY_END = 0;

// pose at t: what the engine draws, plus the un-pivoted lift (anchor points use that, as the mockup does)

function pose(t) {

const dx = valAt(BODY.dx, t), dy = valAt(BODY.dy, t), lift = valAt(BODY.lift, t) + valAt(BODY.hop, t);

const rot = valAt(BODY.rot, t) * DIR * DEG, sx = valAt(BODY.sx, t), sy = valAt(BODY.sy, t);

let air = lift, ddx = dx;

if (valAt(BODY.pivot, t) >= 0.5 && rot) { const r = (dx || dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + dx, y: KF.y + dy }) : 1; const ph = K.h * (K.foot - 0.55) * r * sy; ddx -= ph * Math.sin(rot); air += ph * (1 - Math.cos(rot)); }

return { dx: ddx, dy, air, rot, sx, sy, lift, bx: dx };

}

// moves (mockup: moveActor / goHome / lean / squash / liftTo / spin)

const moveTo = (at, ms, pt, ease, o) => { o = o || {}; key(BODY.dx, at, ms, pt.x - KF.x, ease || EZ.sine); key(BODY.dy, at, ms, pt.y - KF.y, ease || EZ.sine); if (o.hop) { const h = o.hop * KP; keyFn(BODY.hop, at, ms, (u) => Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * h); } if (o.trail) for (const f of [0.31, 0.62, 0.93]) ghostAt(at + ms * f, o.ghost || {}); return at + ms; };

const goHome = (at, ms, o) => moveTo(at, ms, KF, EZ.quad, o);

const lean = (at, ms, deg, ease) => { key(BODY.rot, at, ms, deg, ease || EZ.out); return at + ms; };

const squash = (at, ms, sx, sy, ease) => { key(BODY.sx, at, ms, sx, ease || EZ.out); key(BODY.sy, at, ms, sy, ease || EZ.out); return at + ms; };

const liftTo = (at, ms, h, ease) => { key(BODY.lift, at, ms, h * KP, ease || EZ.outCubic); return at + ms; };

const pivot = (at, mid) => key(BODY.pivot, at, 0, mid ? 1 : 0);

// anchor points on the caster (mockup hand(a) / bodyAt(a) / feet(a)), at time t

const casterPt = (t, u, v) => { const p = pose(t), r = (p.bx || p.dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + p.bx, y: KF.y + p.dy }) : 1; return { x: KF.x + p.bx + DIR * K.w * u * r, y: KF.y + p.dy - p.lift - HB('k') * v * r }; };

const hand = (t) => casterPt(t, 0.3, 0.62);

const bodyAt = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0.5);

const cFeet = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0);

const headAt = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0.95);

// ── art copies: afterimage ghosts, scaling copies, a glow ring behind the body ──────────────

const ART = tl.art('k');

const bake = (filter, pad) => { if (!ART) return null; const w = ART.naturalWidth || ART.videoWidth || ART.width, h = ART.naturalHeight || ART.videoHeight || ART.height; if (!w || !h) return null; pad = pad || 0;

const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w + pad * 2; c.height = h + pad * 2; const x = c.getContext('2d'); try { x.filter = filter || 'none'; x.drawImage(ART, pad, pad, w, h); } catch (e) { return null; } return { cv: c, pad, w, h }; };

const GHOST = {};

const ghostImg = (o) => { const f = o.filter || (o.hue == null ? 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)' : 'sepia(1) saturate(5) hue-rotate(' + (o.hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)'); if (!(f in GHOST)) GHOST[f] = bake(f, 0); return GHOST[f]; };

// draw a copy of the caster's art at pose p (es = extra scale about the feet)

function drawCopy(g, B, p, alpha, es) {

if (!B || alpha <= 0) return; es = es || 1;

const r = (p.dx || p.dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + p.dx, y: KF.y + p.dy }) : 1;

const padW = B.pad * K.w / B.w, padH = B.pad * K.h / B.h;

g.save(); g.translate(K.x + p.dx, KF.y + p.dy - p.air); if (p.rot) g.rotate(p.rot); g.scale(K.flip * p.sx * r * es, p.sy * r * es); g.globalAlpha = alpha;

g.drawImage(B.cv, -K.w / 2 - padW, -K.h * K.foot - padH, K.w + padW * 2, K.h + padH * 2); g.restore();

}

// one ghost spawned at 'at' showing the pose of that moment, fading over o.ms (mockup afterimage)

const GHOSTS = [];

function ghostAt(at, o) { o = o || {}; GHOSTS.push({ at, ms: o.ms || 380, op: o.opacity == null ? 0.5 : o.opacity, img: ghostImg(o) }); }

// ghosts every 'every' ms from 'from' to 'to' (mockup trailWhile)

function trail(from, to, every, o) { for (let t = from; t < to; t += every) ghostAt(t, o); }

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => { if (!GHOSTS.length) return; S.world.push({ z: 4, draw: (g) => { for (const q of GHOSTS) { const age = t - q.at; if (age < 0 || age > q.ms) continue; drawCopy(g, q.img, pose(q.at), q.op * (1 - age / q.ms)); } } }); });

// ── the stepped particle field (mockup addP / frame): positions scene px, velocities mockup px/ms ──

// layers: ground (under the battlers), field (over them), hit (over everything on the board)

const PL = { ground: [], field: [], hit: [] };

const LZ = { ground: 2, field: 24, hit: 46 };

const addP = (layer, p) => { PL[layer].push(Object.assign({ t: 0, life: 1000, vx: 0, vy: 0, g: 0, drag: 1 }, p)); };

const spawn = (at, fn) => once(at, fn);

let lastT = null;

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => {

const dt = lastT == null ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(50, t - lastT)); lastT = t;

for (const L in PL) { const arr = PL[L]; for (let i = arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = arr[i]; p.t += dt;

if (p.t >= p.life || p.dead) { arr.splice(i, 1); continue; }

if (p.update) p.update(p, dt); else { p.vy += p.g * dt; const f = Math.pow(p.drag, dt / 16); p.vx *= f; p.vy *= f; p.x += p.vx * dt * KP; p.y += p.vy * dt * KP; } }

if (arr.length) S.world.push({ z: LZ[L], draw: (g) => { for (const p of arr) { g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = p.comp || 'lighter'; try { p.draw(g, p, Math.min(1, p.t / p.life)); } catch (e) {} g.restore(); } } }); }

});

// mockup glow(c, x, y, r, rgb, a): a radial gradient disc

const glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7); g.fill(); };

// floor ring (ellipse) growing r0 -> r1

function ring(at, pt, o) { o = o || {}; const rgb = o.rgb || '255,255,255', r0 = o.r0 == null ? 10 : o.r0, r1 = o.r1 == null ? 160 : o.r1, ms = o.ms || 600, sy = o.sy == null ? 0.3 : o.sy, w = o.w || 6, layer = o.layer || 'ground';

spawn(at, () => { const s = KP * DR(o.ref || pt); addP(layer, { x: pt.x, y: pt.y, life: ms, update: () => {}, draw: (g, p, t) => { const r = lerp(r0, r1, E.outC(t)) * s; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (1 - t) + ')'; g.lineWidth = w * (1 - t * 0.6) * s; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(p.x, p.y, r, r * sy, 0, 0, 7); g.stroke(); } }); }); }

// floor cracks

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"slash":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/006_slash_physical.webm","w":378,"h":378,"dur":333,"ax":0.4683,"ay":0.5794}},"sfx":{"swingC":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_SWINGC.wav","swingA":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_SWINGA.wav","blowL":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitBlowL.ogg"}};

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Rauben kit (prepended to every Rauben shot by legacy-rauben-signatures.js) ──

// The legacy-boss mockup's shared kit (part-common.js) ported to oni.timeline: sound cues at the

// mockup's loudness, a world-space particle field (dust, coins, twinkles), the afterimage ghost,

// the coin and the thrown axe shapes, depth-scaled bandit runners and the battler size of a bandit.

// Mockup px are on a 1682 px stage; KP scales them to the scene. No backticks, no dollar-brace.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

const VOL = (cfg.volume == null ? 1 : cfg.volume) * 0.75; // mockup sfx(key, v) plays at v * 0.75

const readyHook = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

function RKit(tl, T) {

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const m = tl.mk(T);

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 7331);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const pick = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(R() * arr.length)];

const K = { KP, m, R, rnd, pick, E, seg, lerp };

// the screen px of one mockup stage px (shakes are screen space)

K.SH = () => { try { return tl.view().H / 788; } catch (e) { return 1; } };

// fire once when the run reaches 'at' (a track stays open so a slow frame cannot skip it)

K.once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (did) return; did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[Rauben] cue threw', e); } } }); };

// a sound cue: key in A.sfx, v = the mockup volume; o = { rate, fadeAfter, fadeMs }

K.snd = (at, key, v, o) => { const url = A.sfx && A.sfx[key]; if (!url) return; K.once(at, () => { try { oni.sfx(url, Object.assign({ volume: Math.min(1, v * VOL) }, o || {})); } catch (e) {} }); };

K.shake = (at, ms, px) => { T.push({ t0: at, t1: at + ms, fn: (tt, S) => { S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, px * K.SH() * (1 - tt / ms)); } }); };

K.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2); };

// ── particle field: { t0, life, z, draw(g, u, age) }; z < 5 = under the battlers ──

const P = []; K.P = P;

K.add = (p) => { P.push(p); return p; };

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => {

if (!P.length) return;

const zs = {};

for (let i = P.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = P[i]; if (t >= p.t0 + p.life) { P.splice(i, 1); continue; } if (t < p.t0 || p.dead) continue; (zs[p.z] = zs[p.z] || []).push(p); }

for (const z in zs) { const list = zs[z]; S.world.push({ z: Number(z), draw: (g) => { for (const p of list) { const age = t - p.t0; g.save(); try { p.draw(g, age / p.life, age); } catch (e) {} g.restore(); } } }); }

});

// dust puffs (dustBurst): n puffs thrown up and out from a floor point, drag .97 per frame

K.dust = (at, pt, n, s, rgb, z) => { rgb = rgb || '190,170,140'; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(Math.PI, Math.PI * 2), sp = rnd(0.08, 0.25) * s * KP, vy = rnd(0.02, 0.1) * s * KP, x0 = pt.x + rnd(-10, 10) * s * KP, r = rnd(8, 18) * s * KP;

K.add({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), z: z == null ? 4 : z, draw: (g, u, age) => { const k = (1 - Math.pow(0.97, age / 16.67)) / 0.03 * 16.67; const x = x0 + Math.cos(an) * sp * k, y = pt.y + Math.sin(an) * vy * k; g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.45 * (1 - u)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r * (1 + u), 0, 7); g.fill(); } }); } };

// one drifting puff (a runner's trail)

K.puff = (at, x, y, vx, vy, life, rr, rgb, a0, grow, z) => K.add({ t0: at, life, z, draw: (g, u, age) => { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (a0 * (1 - u)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + vx * age, y + vy * age, rr * (1 + u * grow), 0, 7); g.fill(); } });

// gold twinkles (twinkles)

K.twinkles = (at, pt, n, r, rgb) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = pt.x + rnd(-r, r) * KP, y = pt.y + rnd(-r, r) * 0.8 * KP, s = rnd(5, 11) * KP;

K.add({ t0: at, life: rnd(500, 900), z: 42, draw: (g, u) => { const k = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * s; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; K.glow(g, x, y, k * 2.5, rgb, 0.7); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; g.fillStyle = '#fff';

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y - k * 1.6); g.lineTo(x + k * 0.3, y); g.lineTo(x, y + k * 1.6); g.lineTo(x - k * 0.3, y); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - k * 1.6, y); g.lineTo(x, y + k * 0.3); g.lineTo(x + k * 1.6, y); g.lineTo(x, y - k * 0.3); g.closePath(); g.fill(); } }); } };

// shapes (SHAPE.coin / SHAPE.axe), drawn at the origin

K.coin = (g, age, r) => { const k = Math.abs(Math.cos(age / 70)); g.fillStyle = '#e8b32a'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(0, 0, r * Math.max(0.15, k), r, 0, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#fff3b0'; g.fillRect(-1 * KP, -r * 0.6, 2 * KP, r * 0.5); };

K.axe = (g, s) => { g.scale(s, s); g.strokeStyle = '#4a2f1c'; g.lineWidth = 6; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-30, 0); g.lineTo(30, 0); g.stroke();

g.fillStyle = '#c9ced6'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(18, -4); g.quadraticCurveTo(44, -30, 36, -36); g.quadraticCurveTo(54, -6, 40, 22); g.quadraticCurveTo(40, 6, 18, 4); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.strokeStyle = '#7d1c1c'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke(); };

// a thrown thing (fly): from -> to over ms, arc = mockup px up at mid-flight (negative dips), spin rad per 60 fps frame

K.fly = (at, from, to, o) => { const ms = o.ms; K.add({ t0: at, life: ms, z: o.z == null ? 40 : o.z, draw: (g, u, age) => { const e = (o.ease || E.lin)(Math.min(1, age / ms)); const x = lerp(from().x, to().x, e), y = lerp(from().y, to().y, e) - o.arc * KP * Math.sin(Math.PI * e);

g.translate(x, y); if (o.spin) g.rotate(o.spin * age / 16.67); o.draw(g, age); } }); };

// afterimage: a pale copy of a timeline token's art at its painted spot, fading over ms

K.ghost = (at, k, pose, o) => { o = o || {}; const art = tl.art(k), Tk = tl.TOK[k]; if (!art || !Tk) return; const ms = o.ms || 380, a0 = o.opacity || 0.5;

K.add({ t0: at, life: ms, z: 4, draw: (g, u) => { const f = tl.feet(Tk); g.translate(Tk.x + pose.dx, f.y + pose.dy - (pose.air || 0)); if (pose.rot) g.rotate(pose.rot); g.scale(Tk.flip * (pose.sx || 1), pose.sy || 1); g.globalAlpha = a0 * (1 - u); g.filter = 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)'; g.drawImage(art, -Tk.w / 2, -Tk.h * Tk.foot, Tk.w, Tk.h); } }); };

// the drawn height of a bandit art in the game: a 1x1 token box ("contain") times its texture scale, times the depth there

K.banditH = (img, sc, ds) => { const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; return nh * Math.min(tl.GRID / nw, tl.GRID / nh) * sc * ds; };

// where a body standing on a 2D floor point is drawn, and how big ({ x, y, s })

// cfg.flat (full-takeover shots: the 3D stage flattens) = the 2D point itself, sized by the depth-map factor only

K.floor = (x, y) => { try { const d = oni.depthAt({ x, y }); if (cfg.flat) return { x, y, s: d && Number.isFinite(d.f) && d.f > 0 ? d.f : 1 }; if (d && Number.isFinite(d.s) && d.s > 0) return d; } catch (e) {} return { x, y, s: 1 }; };

// the board edges in world px right now (live board: the real camera)

K.edges = () => { try { const v = tl.camView(tl.makeState()); return { left: v.left, right: v.right, top: v.top, bottom: v.bottom }; } catch (e) { return { left: tl.STAGE.x, right: tl.STAGE.x + tl.STAGE.w, top: tl.STAGE.y, bottom: tl.STAGE.y + tl.STAGE.h }; } };

// a bandit sprite running across the board: img, dir (+1 = to the right), x0 -> x1, row y, h, ms, ease,

// bob(u) mockup px up, rot(u) deg, fade-in ms, z; trail = puff spacing ms (0 = none)

K.runner = (at, o) => { const img = o.img; if (!img) return; const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1, h = o.h, w = h * nw / nh;

const pos = (age) => { const u = Math.min(1, age / o.ms), e = (o.ease || E.lin)(u); return { u, x: lerp(o.x0, o.x1, e), y: lerp(o.y, o.y1 == null ? o.y : o.y1, e) }; };

K.add({ t0: at, life: o.ms, z: o.z, draw: (g, u0, age) => { const p = pos(age); g.translate(p.x, p.y - (o.bob ? o.bob(p.u) : 0)); if (o.rot) g.rotate(o.rot(p.u) * Math.PI / 180 * o.dir); g.scale(-o.dir, 1);

g.globalAlpha = o.fade ? Math.min(1, age / o.fade) : 1; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); } });

if (o.trail) for (let a = 0; a < o.ms; a += o.trail) { const p = pos(a); const tr = o.trailSpec(p, w, h); K.puff(at + a, tr.x, tr.y, tr.vx, tr.vy, tr.life, tr.rr, tr.rgb, tr.a0, tr.grow, tr.z == null ? o.z - 1 : tr.z); }

return { w, h };

};

return K;

}

// ── shot ──

// Rauben · Great Axe (+ Great Axe - Counterattack) / Axe Throw / Bandit Raid / All you can take (inner script, every client).

// Port of the approved legacy-boss mockup (part-b3.js, Rauben defs). LIVE board: the camera is never touched,

// only the bodies a beat moves are painted. cfg.move = "greataxe" | "axethrow" | "raid" | "allyoucan".

// Every damage contact cues oni.hit(); the damage gate (oni.fireDone) sits where the mockup marks it.

// Numbers, flinch and HP bar are the game's. No floating text, no backticks in this file.

if (!caster) { readyHook(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const MOVE = cfg.move;

const ALL = MOVE === 'allyoucan';

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

// All you can take: every creature on the board gains IP (the item's resolution grants it to every token)

const CREW = [];

if (ALL) {

const seen = new Set([caster.id]); const disp = Number(caster.document && caster.document.disposition) || 0; const list = [];

for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (!t || !t.actor || seen.has(t.id) || !t.visible || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; seen.add(t.id); list.push(t); }

list.sort((a, b) => ((Number(a.document.disposition) === disp) ? 1 : 0) - ((Number(b.document.disposition) === disp) ? 1 : 0));

list.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 'c' + i; CREW.push({ k, token: t }); if (!tokens[k]) tokens[k] = { token: t }; });

CREW.push({ k: 'k', token: caster });

}

if (!ALL && !FOES.length) { readyHook(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const A_IMG = A.images || {};

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A_IMG, live: true, depthRef: 'k' });

await tl.load();

const T = [];

const RK = RKit(tl, T);

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = RK.KP, m = RK.m, rnd = RK.rnd;

const CL = A.clips || {};

const K = TOK.k, kf = feet(K);

const center = (k) => { const Tk = TOK[k], f = feet(Tk); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - Tk.h * 0.5 }; };

const DIR = FOES.length ? (feet(TOK[FOES[0]]).x >= kf.x ? 1 : -1) : (() => { const o = CREW.find((c) => c.k !== 'k' && Number(c.token.document.disposition) !== Number(caster.document.disposition)); return o && feet(TOK[o.k]).x < kf.x ? -1 : 1; })();

const D2R = Math.PI / 180;

// a mockup lean (deg, positive = toward the party) as a canvas rotation

const lean = (deg) => deg * DIR * D2R;

const clipW = (key, scale) => CL[key].w * scale * 0.55 * KP;

// keyframed value: keys [{ t0, ms, to, ease }] run back to back from 0

const curve = (keys, t) => { let v = 0; for (const q of keys) { if (t < q.t0) break; v = lerp(v, q.to, (q.ease || E.outQ)(seg(t, q.t0, q.t0 + q.ms))); } return v; };

let total = 0, gate = 0, poseAt = null;

if (MOVE === 'greataxe') {

// ── Great Axe: dash, overhead swing, hit, two coins to him, back ──

const tk = FOES[0], tf = feet(TOK[tk]), c = center(tk);

const DEST = { x: tf.x - DIR * cfg.gap * KP * tl.depthRatio(kf, tf), y: tf.y };

const D = cfg.dash, WIND = D + cfg.wind, CUT = WIND + cfg.swing, STEAL = CUT + cfg.hitstop, GATE = STEAL + cfg.coinMs, SETTLE = GATE + cfg.settle, HOME = SETTLE + cfg.home;

total = HOME + 300; gate = GATE;

const rotKeys = [{ t0: D, ms: cfg.wind, to: -16 }, { t0: WIND, ms: cfg.swing, to: 16 }, { t0: GATE, ms: cfg.settle, to: 0 }];

poseAt = (t) => { let x = kf.x, y = kf.y, air = 0;

if (t < D) { const u = E.ioQ(seg(t, 0, D)); x = lerp(kf.x, DEST.x, u); y = lerp(kf.y, DEST.y, u); }

else if (t < SETTLE) { x = DEST.x; y = DEST.y; }

else { const u = E.ioQ(seg(t, SETTLE, HOME)); x = lerp(DEST.x, kf.x, u); y = lerp(DEST.y, kf.y, u); air = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * cfg.hop * KP; }

return { dx: x - kf.x, dy: y - kf.y, air, rot: lean(curve(rotKeys, t)), sx: 1, sy: 1 }; };

// the dash leaves three afterimages (trail .3 of the eased move)

for (const e of [0.3, 0.6, 0.9]) { const u = e < 0.5 ? Math.sqrt(e / 2) : 1 - Math.sqrt((1 - e) / 2); const at = Math.round(u * D) + 1; RK.ghost(at, 'k', poseAt(at)); }

RK.snd(WIND, 'swingF', 0.55);

m.clip('slash3', CUT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('slash3', 1.2), z: 40 });

RK.once(CUT, () => oni.hit());

RK.snd(CUT, 'blowL', 0.6); RK.shake(CUT, 260, 10);

RK.snd(STEAL, 'steal', 0.45); RK.snd(STEAL, 'coin', 0.45);

// coinsTo: two coins hop from the target to him (resolves when the first lands = the gate)

const to = () => ({ x: DEST.x, y: DEST.y - K.h * tl.depthRatio(kf, DEST) * 0.5 });

for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { const ox = rnd(-12, 12) * KP, arc = rnd(70, 130); RK.fly(STEAL + i * 70, () => ({ x: c.x + ox, y: c.y }), to, { ms: cfg.coinMs, arc, ease: E.sine, z: 41, draw: (g, age) => RK.coin(g, age, 7 * KP) }); }

}

if (MOVE === 'axethrow') {

// ── Axe Throw: a spinning axe flies out, hits, and arcs back into his hand ──

const tk = FOES[0], c = center(tk);

const hand = () => ({ x: kf.x + DIR * K.w * 0.3, y: kf.y - K.h * 0.62 });

const W1 = cfg.wind, HIT = W1 + cfg.out, BACK = HIT + cfg.back, SQ = BACK + 90, SQ2 = SQ + 120, END = SQ2 + 140;

total = END + 300; gate = HIT;

const rotKeys = [{ t0: 0, ms: cfg.wind, to: -12 }, { t0: W1, ms: 100, to: 10 }, { t0: SQ2, ms: 140, to: 0 }];

const sqKeys = (t) => t < BACK ? 1 : t < SQ ? lerp(1, 1.05, E.outQ(seg(t, BACK, SQ))) : lerp(1.05, 1, E.outQ(seg(t, SQ, SQ2)));

poseAt = (t) => { const sx = sqKeys(t), sy = 2 - sx; return { dx: 0, dy: 0, air: 0, rot: lean(curve(rotKeys, t)), sx, sy }; };

RK.snd(W1, 'swingC', 0.5);

RK.fly(W1, hand, () => c, { ms: cfg.out, arc: 60, spin: 0.35, z: 40, draw: (g) => RK.axe(g, 1.1 * KP) });

m.clip('slash', HIT, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('slash', 1), z: 41 });

RK.once(HIT, () => oni.hit());

RK.snd(HIT, 'blowL', 0.5); RK.snd(HIT, 'swingA', 0.4);

RK.fly(HIT, () => c, hand, { ms: cfg.back, arc: -70, spin: 0.35, z: 40, draw: (g) => RK.axe(g, 1.1 * KP) });

}

if (MOVE === 'raid') {

// ── Bandit Raid: he whistles; three bandits dash through the target from off-screen, one hit at the end ──

const tk = FOES[0], tf = feet(TOK[tk]), c = center(tk);

const W0 = 160, WEND = W0 + 300 + 160, RUN = WEND;

const LAST = RUN + 2 * cfg.stagger + cfg.runMs;

total = LAST + 400; gate = LAST;

const rotKeys = [{ t0: 0, ms: 160, to: 6 }, { t0: W0 + 300, ms: 160, to: 0 }];

poseAt = (t) => ({ dx: 0, dy: 0, air: 0, rot: lean(curve(rotKeys, t)), sx: 1, sy: 1 });

RK.snd(W0, 'item', 0.4);

const ed = RK.edges();

const x0 = (DIR > 0 ? ed.left : ed.right) - DIR * 120 * KP, x1 = (DIR > 0 ? ed.right : ed.left) + DIR * 218 * KP;

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

const art = RK.pick(cfg.bandits), img = tl.IMG[art]; if (!img) continue;

const y = tf.y + (i - 1) * 18 * KP, h = RK.banditH(img, cfg.bsc[art] || 1.34, tl.depthS(tf.x, y)), z = y < tf.y ? 3 : 30;

RK.runner(RUN + i * cfg.stagger, { img, dir: DIR, x0, x1, y, h, ms: cfg.runMs, ease: E.lin, z,

bob: (u) => Math.abs(Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 9)) * 8 * KP, rot: (u) => Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 9) * 4,

trail: 64, trailSpec: (p) => ({ x: p.x - DIR * 20 * KP, y: p.y, vx: -0.05 * DIR * KP, vy: -0.02 * KP, life: 500, rr: rnd(5, 10) * KP, rgb: '190,170,140', a0: 0.4, grow: 1 }) });

}

m.clip('hit', LAST, { x: c.x, y: c.y, w: clipW('hit', 1), z: 41 });

RK.once(LAST, () => oni.hit());

RK.snd(LAST, 'blowL', 0.5);

}

if (MOVE === 'allyoucan') {

// ── All you can take: dim, he steps up, coins shower onto every creature, the game's IP number reads the gain ──

const STEP = cfg.step, SHOWER = STEP;

const N = CREW.length, ARRIVE = 560;

const GATE = SHOWER + (N - 1) * 70 + ARRIVE;

const BACK = GATE + 500, HOME = BACK + cfg.home;

total = HOME + 200; gate = GATE;

const DEST = { x: kf.x + DIR * 60 * KP, y: kf.y };

poseAt = (t) => { let x = kf.x; if (t < BACK) x = lerp(kf.x, DEST.x, E.sine(seg(t, 0, STEP))); else x = lerp(DEST.x, kf.x, E.ioQ(seg(t, BACK, HOME))); return { dx: x - kf.x, dy: 0, air: 0, rot: 0, sx: 1, sy: 1 }; };

m.hold(0, total, (t, S) => { const a = t < BACK ? 0.45 * E.sine(seg(t, 0, 400)) : 0.45 * (1 - E.sine(seg(t, BACK, BACK + 400))); S.dim = Math.max(S.dim, a); });

RK.snd(SHOWER, 'coin', 0.5);

const ipGain = (actor) => { const p = (actor && actor.system && actor.system.props) || {}; let cur = Number(p.current_ip), max = Number(p.max_ip);

if (!('current_ip' in p) || !('max_ip' in p)) { const s = (actor && actor.system) || {}; cur = Number(s.current_ip); max = Number(s.max_ip); }

if (!Number.isFinite(cur) || !Number.isFinite(max)) return 0; return Math.max(0, Math.min(max, cur + cfg.gain) - cur); };

const bdNumbers = () => { try { return globalThis.FUCompanion.api.experimental.battleDirector.damageNumbers; } catch (e) { return null; } };

CREW.forEach((cr, i) => {

const at = SHOWER + i * 70, Tk = TOK[cr.k]; if (!Tk) return;

const home = () => { const f = feet(Tk); const dx = cr.k === 'k' ? DEST.x - kf.x : 0; return { x: f.x + dx, y: f.y - Tk.h * 0.5 }; };

for (let n = 0; n < 5; n++) { const ox = rnd(-30, 30) * KP, tx = rnd(-20, 20) * KP;

RK.fly(at, () => ({ x: home().x + ox, y: RK.edges().top - 40 * KP }), () => ({ x: home().x + tx, y: home().y }), { ms: 520 + n * 40, arc: 0, ease: E.inQ, z: 41, draw: (g, age) => RK.coin(g, age, 7 * KP) }); }

RK.snd(at + ARRIVE, 'coin', 0.25);

RK.twinkles(at + ARRIVE, home(), 3, 24, '255,220,120');

const amount = ipGain(cr.token.actor), uuid = cr.token.document && cr.token.document.uuid;

if (amount > 0 && uuid) RK.once(at + ARRIVE, () => { const dn = bdNumbers(); if (dn && dn.renderLocal) dn.renderLocal({ kind: 'gain', tokenUuid: uuid, resource: 'ip', amount }); });

});

}

// his body, every frame of the shot

m.hold(0, total, (t, S) => { if (!poseAt) return; const p = poseAt(t), d = S.tok.k; d.dx = p.dx; d.dy = p.dy; d.air = p.air; d.rot = p.rot; d.sx = p.sx; d.sy = p.sy; });

RK.once(gate, () => oni.fireDone());

await tl.run(T, { total, onStart: readyHook });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 25000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Axe Throw" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

props.animation_script:
// Mug — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"move":"mug","casterFoot":0.95,"partyFoot":0.97,"seed":2525,"volume":0.75,"totalTimeoutMs":15000,"coins":4};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"hit_phys":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/001_hit_physical.webm","w":488,"h":488,"dur":333,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5,"k":0.55,"add":false}},"sfx":{"swingA":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_SWINGA.wav","slash1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Slash1.ogg","steal":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Steal.ogg","coin":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Coin.ogg"},"images":{}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-rauben-mug";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Mug]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

// A Chain tick: reveals the next strike (number, HP bar, counter) on the acting GM.

// info: { numbersOnly, screenAt: { [tokenUuid]: { fx, fy } } } or a function returning it.

// paced: every Zero Power cues each strike itself, so the presenter never fills a gap with its own beat.

ZP.hit = (m, at, info) => ZP.once(m, at, () => oni.hit(Object.assign({ paced: true }, typeof info === 'function' ? info() : (info || {}))));

// The shipped Zero Power cut-in (createCutinDOM/runCutinDOM): a full-body image

// 92% of the view tall on the bottom edge; left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out, 650 ms),

// hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in, 650 ms). Drawn in screen space above the board.

// Needs A.images[key]; Overdrive is a cfg sfx cue at the same time.

ZP.cssOut = (t) => ZP.bez(0, 0, 0.58, 1, t);

ZP.cssIn = (t) => ZP.bez(0.42, 0, 1, 1, t);

ZP.bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const fx = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= fx / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

ZP.cutin = (tl, m, at, key, o) => {

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => { const img = tl.IMG[key]; if (!img) return; (o.over ? S.over : S.screen).push({ draw: (g) => {

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

const x = e < inMs ? -1.2 * g.W * (1 - ZP.cssOut(e / inMs)) : e < inMs + hold ? 0 : 1.2 * g.W * ZP.cssIn((e - inMs - hold) / outMs);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

return at + end;

};

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

// Crysta next to the drawn one). keep: extra tokens to leave alone.

ZP.bystanders = (keep) => {

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

let n = 0; for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; out['b' + (n++)] = { token: t }; }

return out;

};

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

ZP.focus = (m, TOK, at, ms, back, backMs) => {

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

for (const k of keys) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / ms; else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / backMs); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } });

return keys;

};

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

ZP.FLINCH = {

normal: { ms: 300, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.12, 1.12, 0.88, 0], [0.30, 0.97, 1.03, -7], [0.50, 1, 1, 6], [0.70, 1, 1, -4], [0.85, 1, 1, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 3.6], [0.35, 1], [1, 1]] },

strong: { ms: 480, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.10, 1.22, 0.80, 0], [0.26, 0.90, 1.10, -13], [0.44, 1, 1, 11], [0.62, 1, 1, -7], [0.80, 1, 1, 5], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 4], [0.20, 1], [0.40, 3.2], [0.60, 1], [1, 1]] },

};

ZP.stop = (stops, t, col) => { for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) if (t <= stops[i][0]) { const a = stops[i - 1], b = stops[i]; const u = (t - a[0]) / Math.max(1e-6, b[0] - a[0]); const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u); return a[col] + (b[col] - a[col]) * k; } return stops[stops.length - 1][col]; };

// Flinch sample at ms since the hit: { sx, sy, dx, b (brightness) } or null when over.

ZP.flinchAt = (ms, tier) => { const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; if (ms < 0 || ms >= F.ms) return null; const u = ms / F.ms; return { sx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 1), sy: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 2), dx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 3), b: ZP.stop(F.bright, u, 1) }; };

// The hurt reaction on a PAINTED timeline token k at 'at': its hurt art (sprite_hurt,

// the engine's hurt loop) for hurtMs with the flinch on top, else the flinch alone.

// Use with oni.hit({ numbersOnly: true }) so the game's own DOM flinch stays off.

ZP.flinchTok = (m, at, k, tier, hurtMs) => {

const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; const hold = Math.max(F.ms, hurtMs == null ? 700 : hurtMs);

m.hold(at, at + hold, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; q.hurt = true; const f = ZP.flinchAt(e, tier); if (!f) return; q.sx *= f.sx; q.sy *= f.sy; q.dx += f.dx; if (f.b > 1.05) { const a = Math.min(1, (f.b - 1) / 3); if (a > q.tintA) { q.tint = '#ffffff'; q.tintA = a; } } });

};

// Screen anchor for a damage number at screen px (x, y) of the overlay: board-view fractions.

ZP.frac = (g, x, y) => ({ fx: x / g.W, fy: y / g.H });

// Splitting for a drawn pseudo multi-hit preview (bench only; in battle the numbers come from BD).

ZP.split = (total, n) => { const out = []; let prev = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { const c = Math.round(total * i / n); out.push(c - prev); prev = c; } return out; };

// A soft additive glow (canvas 2D).

ZP.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// A deterministic particle field for a track: n particles from seed, each p(i, r) => spec,

// drawn by draw(g, p, e). Lets a whole ember/dust swarm live in one track (no per-frame spawns).

ZP.swarm = (tl, n, seed, make) => { const r = tl.rng(seed || 3); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(make(i, r)); return out; };

// A glow-sprite with a black backing turned into real alpha (alpha = brightness), cached.

ZP._ga = new Map();

ZP.glowAlpha = (img) => { if (!img) return null; if (ZP._ga.has(img)) return ZP._ga.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; if (!w || !h) return null; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

try { const id = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h), d = id.data; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { const mx = Math.max(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]); if (mx > 0) { d[i] = d[i] * 255 / mx; d[i + 1] = d[i + 1] * 255 / mx; d[i + 2] = d[i + 2] * 255 / mx; } d[i + 3] = mx; } x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); } catch (e) { return img; }

ZP._ga.set(img, cv); return cv; };

// Tip and joint of a Disgaea weapon part, read from its alpha (top-most / bottom-most opaque rows).

ZP._li = new Map();

ZP.limbInfo = (img) => { if (ZP._li.has(img)) return ZP._li.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); let d; try { d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; } catch (e) { const r0 = { tip: { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r0); return r0; }

const row = (y) => { let a = -1, b = -1; for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 90) { if (a < 0) a = i; b = i; } return a < 0 ? null : (a + b) / 2; };

let tip = null, joint = null; for (let y = 0; y < h && !tip; y++) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) tip = { x: c, y }; } for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0 && !joint; y--) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) joint = { x: c, y }; }

const r = { tip: tip || { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: joint || { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r); return r; };

// ── Legacy twins kit (Jack + Jill, + the shared Mug / Cleaving Strike Rauben also uses) ──────────────

// Prepended (after the Zero Power kit) by legacy-twins-signatures.js. A canvas-2D port of the mockup's

// shared kit ("Legacy boss animations" mockup, part-common.js + the round-3 afterimage / comic puff):

// a keyframed body for the caster, afterimage ghosts, a stepped particle field (ground / field / hit

// layers), projectiles with glow trails, rings, cracks, dust, twinkles, wisps, coins, the impact frame,

// radial speed lines and the pixel-crisp Zero Power cut-in.

// LIVE board: the camera is never touched; only bodies a beat moves are painted. Every mockup number is

// in mockup px on a 1682 px stage and is scaled by KP (stage width / 1682) and the depth ratio.

// Mirroring: the mockup's enemy faces right; every x offset and rotation is multiplied by DIR.

// No backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

const CL = A.clips || {};

// cfg.live false = FULL TAKEOVER (the shot owns the board and drives S.cam: Apex Arrow's push-in); else LIVE board

const LIVE = cfg.live !== false;

const tl = oni.timeline(LIVE ? { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {}, live: true, depthRef: 'k' } : { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {} });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 2525);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (!did) { did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ONI][twins] cue threw', e); } } } }); };

const S_ = (at, url, v) => { if (url) sfx.push({ at: Math.round(at), url, v: v * (cfg.volume == null ? 0.75 : cfg.volume) }); };

const SX = (at, key, v) => S_(at, (A.sfx || {})[key], v);

const DEG = Math.PI / 180;

const K = TOK.k, KF = feet(K);

// facing: toward the first target; with none (a self-cast) the way the caster's art faces

const DIR = FOES.length ? (TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1) : (K.dir || 1);

const DR = (pt) => tl.depthRatio(KF, pt); // size at pt vs the caster's spot

const HB = (k) => TOK[k].h * TOK[k].foot; // body height above the feet

const tFeet = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

const tCenter = (k) => { const f = feet(TOK[k]); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - HB(k) * 0.5 }; };

// a spot in front of a target, on the caster's side (the mockup's front(t, gap))

const front = (k, gap) => { const f = tFeet(k); return { x: f.x - DIR * gap * KP * DR(f), y: f.y }; };

// EASE names as the mockup has them

const EZ = { lin: E.lin, quad: E.ioQ, out: E.outQ, in: E.inQ, outCubic: E.outC, sine: E.sine };

const EOUTBACK = (u) => { const c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1; return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(u - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(u - 1, 2); };

// ── the caster's body: keyframed channels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

// dx / dy (scene px), lift (scene px), rot (deg, the mockup's enemy sign), sx / sy, hop (an arc on top

// of the lift), pivot (0 = feet, 1 = the mockup's 50% 55% spin pivot).

const chan = (v0) => ({ v0, segs: [] });

const valAt = (c, t) => { let v = c.v0; for (const s of c.segs) { if (t < s.t0) break; const u = s.t1 > s.t0 ? Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / (s.t1 - s.t0)) : 1; v = s.fn ? (t >= s.t1 ? s.fn(1) : s.fn(u)) : (t >= s.t1 ? s.to : lerp(s.from, s.to, s.ease(u))); } return v; };

const key = (c, at, ms, to, ease) => { const from = valAt(c, at); c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(0, ms), from, to, ease: ease || E.lin }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const keyFn = (c, at, ms, fn) => { c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(1, ms), fn }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const BODY = { dx: chan(0), dy: chan(0), lift: chan(0), hop: chan(0), rot: chan(0), sx: chan(1), sy: chan(1), pivot: chan(0) };

let BODY_END = 0;

// pose at t: what the engine draws, plus the un-pivoted lift (anchor points use that, as the mockup does)

function pose(t) {

const dx = valAt(BODY.dx, t), dy = valAt(BODY.dy, t), lift = valAt(BODY.lift, t) + valAt(BODY.hop, t);

const rot = valAt(BODY.rot, t) * DIR * DEG, sx = valAt(BODY.sx, t), sy = valAt(BODY.sy, t);

let air = lift, ddx = dx;

if (valAt(BODY.pivot, t) >= 0.5 && rot) { const r = (dx || dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + dx, y: KF.y + dy }) : 1; const ph = K.h * (K.foot - 0.55) * r * sy; ddx -= ph * Math.sin(rot); air += ph * (1 - Math.cos(rot)); }

return { dx: ddx, dy, air, rot, sx, sy, lift, bx: dx };

}

// moves (mockup: moveActor / goHome / lean / squash / liftTo / spin)

// ── shot ──

// ── shared: Mug and Cleaving Strike (Jill, and Rauben with his own flavour) ──

// Port of the approved legacy boss mockup (part-b2.js mug() / cleave()). cfg.move = 'mug' | 'cleave';

BODY_END = goHome(G + 150, 420, { hop: 22 });

// Cleaving Strike: steps up to the party, one wide sweep, a hit cue on each target as it passes

const order = FOES.slice().sort((a, b) => tFeet(a).y - tFeet(b).y);

const xs = order.map((k) => tFeet(k).x), near = DIR > 0 ? Math.min(...xs) : Math.max(...xs);

const TAG = "[CL-RES][IP-DRAIN-4]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? p?.__confirmArgs ?? {};

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const userActor = await context.helpers.getAttackerActor();

if (!userActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing user actor.");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found.");

return;

}

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args?.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

const escapeHTML = foundry?.utils?.escapeHTML ?? ((v) => String(v ?? ""));

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= targetDef;

};

const getUserTokenName = () => {

if (typeof _token !== "undefined" && _token?.name) return _token.name;

return userActor?.name ?? "User";

};

const getTargetDisplayName = (targetDoc, targetActor) => {

return targetDoc?.name ?? targetActor?.name ?? "Target";

};

async function postStealFeedbackHtml(innerHtml) {

const FLAG_SCOPE = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const FLAG_KEY = "oniHideChatHeader";

let hookId = null;

hookId = Hooks.on("renderChatMessage", (message, html) => {

if (!message?.getFlag?.(FLAG_SCOPE, FLAG_KEY)) return;

html.find(".message-header").remove();

html.find(".message-sender").remove();

html.find(".message-metadata").remove();

html.find(".message-avatar").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-container").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-message-portrait").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-image").remove();

html.find("img.chat-portrait").remove();

Hooks.off("renderChatMessage", hookId);

});

await ChatMessage.create({

user: game.user.id,

type: CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPES.OTHER,

speaker: { alias: "" },

content: `

${innerHtml}

`,

flags: {

[FLAG_SCOPE]: {

[FLAG_KEY]: true

}

}

});

}

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const userTokenName = getUserTokenName();

const targetName = getTargetDisplayName(targetDoc, targetActor);

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

const hit = isHit(targetUuid, targetActor);

console.log(TAG, "HIT CHECK", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

accTotal,

hasAccuracy,

autoHit,

targetDef,

hit

});

if (!hit) {

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(targetActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userMaxIp = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.max_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const requestedSteal = 4;

// The steal amount depends only on the target's current IP.

// Even if the user is already at max IP, the target still loses IP.

const actualSteal = Math.min(requestedSteal, targetIpBefore);

if (actualSteal <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No IP stolen", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

targetIpBefore,

userIpBefore,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpAfter = Math.max(0, targetIpBefore - actualSteal);

// User gain is clamped by max IP, but does not affect the steal amount.

const actualGain = Math.min(actualSteal, Math.max(0, userMaxIp - userIpBefore));

const userIpAfter = Math.min(userMaxIp, userIpBefore + actualGain);

await targetActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(targetIpAfter)

});

await userActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(userIpAfter)

});

console.log(TAG, "IP TRANSFER APPLIED", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

actualSteal,

actualGain,

targetIpBefore,

targetIpAfter,

userIpBefore,

userIpAfter,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(

`${escapeHTML(userTokenName)} steals ${escapeHTML(actualSteal)} IP from ${escapeHTML(targetName)}!`

);

}
